| | **From The Chairman**
---
| | China and Iran aren’t content to try and suppress dissent at home, they’re [actively trying](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=e220fb8fb56249f8be29f0f9d806c95d&_e=ILrfPUwgIjRG58afwPGKMKv2v5-CLP5s-q82zndsbiT9Iuv5BDZvkzgp8ID92029XoIBkXSluuGmw3AwOzeJ-GHEmfYLeFFiPJmEnR63T6LV5B2u0yeRYseVpI5pCgwVCLs4ozPj3wK_JB9gyQP6si3IXD9eLK9Va7VZUFEDrJ9tp-6ZMTIDKplECk3vvtQ-ZBg-k9bazxMfWVBSa0r76_cnu9HzODba7JZGT0kNgX4PGQILb5XJIEYK5WaU0PwwWzIHCe3KZ1iGqqSROXQjbp3EcTX-AuUerrOymeR_z-chWrcp6MfjWCn6TzH9ienm) to do it here in America. The regimes in Beijing and Tehran are using private investigators, their own intelligence officers, and even criminal gangs to target and harass those who try to speak up about their country’s abuses at home and abroad. The Department of Justice and the FBI have built multiple cases and charged numerous individuals for attempting ‘transnational intimidation’. We shouldn’t be surprised by this, but we should be outraged. Just last year it [emerged](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=e220fb8fb56249f8be29f0f9d806c95d&_e=ILrfPUwgIjRG58afwPGKMCo0Q2kkdbfJTmVS6vSZfh7g_s3fkJWbJWNYllokAtmqiHt1v-isMm8j4McSWWf7FY2LRNLj5s9KnZ76sK7cMV4w7ugpkn7dlYyuEFVQzhE61_yHFSU8cPCcM4ut2YZixYnXKG4ayiiRnVvsZVLbK68ffMRaSoHR2nhGWz1Y0ikUXi5DS9XTj_6E2vqmAmDRY-eASRvwyOJBD3RqmNaR6pBHkZxxTRhn76THbGISmV7YWxwxnbwicGPUX75hNdZD7w%3D%3D) that China was operating ‘police stations’ in New York attempting to target dissidents and quash free speech. This is an insidious part of Chinese influence operations, targeting their own overseas citizens and those of Chinese descent, creating atmospheres of fear and stifling free discussion and debate—hallmarks of what makes America great. We need Washington to make it clear that this type of behavior is unacceptable and that it will be punished to the full extent of the law.

body:
Help us reach 5,000 signatures demanding a judiciary that works for people and our planet.

Tell Congress to Rein in the Supreme Court

The Supreme Court just heard arguments in two key cases that threaten the EPA's and other agencies' ability to protect the people from big business.

Congress must stop MAGA judges' right-wing power grab. Help us reach 5,000 signatures demanding that Congress rein in the Supreme Court and urgently prioritize confirming pro-environment, pro-democracy judges. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/6Lg6B~3_- TAKE ACTION NOW https://links.messages.lcv.

Peter - the Supreme Court just heard arguments in two critical cases - Relentless, Inc. v. Department of Commerce and Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo - that could gut the federal government's authority to enforce even the most basic environmental protections.

In both cases, corporate interests backed by big oil are suing in order to hamstring federal agencies' authority to protect people from powerful special interests. If these plaintiffs get their way, it would move authority over every area of public policy from public-interest agencies like the EPA to the MAGA-dominated federal courts.

In the last two years, extremist Justices on the Supreme Court have already severely limited the federal government's ability to regulate climate pollution from power plants, stripped Clean Water Act protections from most of the wetlands in the United States, and overturned Roe v. Wade. Some even take lavish gifts like private jet flights from the same billionaires bringing cases like this for them to rule on. Now, they're looking to overturn a bedrock doctrine of the American legal system in order to increase their own power.

Our planet and our communities are counting on us - we need your help to make our voices heard. We're asking 5,000 LCV members to take action before midnight tonight. Tell Congress to take action to rein in the Supreme Court and fill judicial vacancies with pro-environment, pro-democracy judges before it's too late >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_

These critical cases target what's called the Chevron Doctrine. This longstanding Supreme Court precedent says that when something is unclear in a federal law administered by an expert agency, such as the way the EPA administers the Clean Air Act, federal courts should defer to agency experts' reasonable interpretations of what the law means. The Chevron Doctrine is critical to enforcing the laws that protect our environment and our communities from pollution and other harms. It touches every issue, from climate to democracy to healthcare, reproductive rights, consumer protection, workers' rights, student debt, and so much more.

Put simply, if the Supreme Court rules in favor of the plaintiffs in Relentless and Loper Bright, it will gut the ability of federal agencies like the EPA to implement the laws Congress passes, transferring that power to unelected right-wing judges. And if Congress doesn't act, far-right judges will keep control of our Supreme Court, and keep rolling back our rights, for decades to come.

Congress must stop this MAGA power grab. We need lawmakers to pass the Judiciary Act to expand and rebalance the Supreme Court. They must also pass the Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal, and Transparency (SCERT) Act to ensure our nation's highest court doesn't have the lowest ethical standards. And we need the Senate to prioritize confirming President Biden's pro-environment, pro-democracy judicial nominees to every vacancy on the federal bench.

We can rein in corrupt MAGA judges, Peter, but it will only happen if our movement joins together to demand it. Please, take action right now. Tell Congress to rein in the Supreme Court and fill judicial vacancies. It only takes a moment to help us reach our goal >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzsVGwd_

Thank you for joining LCV's campaign for a democracy that works for our planet and for our communities.

Onward,

Doug Lindner

Raimondo - that could gut the federal government's authority to enforce even the most basic environmental protections. In both cases, corporate interests backed by big oil are suing in order to hamstring federal agencies' authority to protect people from powerful special interests. If these plaintiffs get their way, it would move authority over every area of public policy from public-interest agencies like the EPA to the MAGA-dominated federal courts. In the last two years, extremist Justices on the Supreme Court have already severely limited the federal government's ability to regulate climate pollution from power plants, stripped Clean Water Act protections from most of the wetlands in the United States, and overturned Roe v. Wade. Some even take lavish gifts like private jet flights from the same billionaires bringing cases like this for them to rule on. Now, they're looking to overturn a bedrock doctrine of the American legal system in order to increase their own power. Our planet and our communities are counting on us - we need your help to make our voices heard. We're asking 5,000 LCV members to take action before midnight tonight. Tell Congress to take action to rein in the Supreme Court and fill judicial vacancies with pro-environment, pro-democracy judges before it's too late >> These critical cases target what's called the Chevron Doctrine. This longstanding Supreme Court precedent says that when something is unclear in a federal law administered by an expert agency, such as the way the EPA administers the Clean Air Act, federal courts should defer to agency experts' reasonable interpretations of what the law means. The Chevron Doctrine is critical to enforcing the laws that protect our environment and our communities from pollution and other harms. It touches every issue, from climate to democracy to healthcare, reproductive rights, consumer protection, workers' rights, student debt, and so much more. We need lawmakers to pass the Judiciary Act to expand and rebalance the Supreme Court. And we need the Senate to prioritize confirming President Biden's pro-environment, pro-democracy judicial nominees to every vacancy on the federal bench. We can rein in corrupt MAGA judges, Peter, but it will only happen if our movement joins together to demand it. Please, take action right now. On the one-year anniversary of the Dobbs decision, she even released this statement:

“Over the past 365 days, the women of our nation have suffered under the consequences of these laws. In addition to the taking of rights, these laws have created chaos, confusion, and fear.”

Now, she's criss-crossing Battleground States across the country trying to brainwash college kids into supporting more abortion!

And while the media mob and the D.C. Swamp crave this insanity . . .

I want to know what you think.

Dear Fellow Patriot,

Are you sick to death of watching our Second Amendment freedoms suffer under a President who has painted you as an enemy of the state?

Do you feel like gun owners are being systematically targeted by the government?

_If you don’t, you should._

Because Biden’s ATF will stop at nothing until they have every single gun, gun owner, and firearm distributor registered and marked.

**_They’re already harassing local gun stores, busting down their doors in a SWAT team fashion_**.

**_It’s only a matter of time before they come for every last one of us_**.

And now, to top it all off, Biden has created another bureaucratic agency with a singular mission: dismantling the Second Amendment.

A **_super-ATF_** , if you will.

**They hate us. They hate our way of life. They hate everything we stand for. And they’re trying to make our lives a living Hell**.

I’ve had enough.

And so should you.

_So how about we give the liberal gun grabbers something else to whine about?_

**_I’m proud to announce the largest giveaway we’ve ever done_**.

**[As a “thank you” to you for your tireless efforts, we’re giving one lucky winner a 2023 Toyota Tacoma TRD Pro AND a custom cerakoted LWRC IC DI rifle in our 2A Technical Giveaway](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=yeh5rdalaxu3qnzzqzgk8wf6tw4q72gsqtcahtdsi0uuw7cd1dr6ulb7ummudv6nny9zuf8amwpf0f38mro0dj5vtzybskke3b3sarwnodwpuwu6f85pkrghqpoylgz7xl089cubchtyrt9v0bcsmyvl5ipgaspzknubboz593c8oqbzx17awsjekhcidjt&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sd48kh)**!

That’s right – this **_2A Technical Giveaway_ is over _$65,000_ in value**.

This 4x4 double-cab truck consists of a 3.5L V6 engine with 278 horsepower and a five-foot bed.

**_This thing is a BEAST_**.

It also has:
* Multi-Terrain Monitor (MTM) * with camera
* Black TRD Pro leather-trimmed front seats with 10-way power-adjustable driver’s seat
* LED headlights with sequential turn signals, Daytime Running Lights (DRL), Rigid Industries® * fog lights, black sport bezels
* Blind Spot Monitor (BSM) * with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert (RCTA) *
* Smart Key System

And so much more!

If that weren’t enough, this giveaway also includes a top-of-the-line **LWRC IC DI rifle in 5.56 (which Biden is trying to BAN)** , with:
* Aimpoint T2 red dot on a Reptilia mount
* Arisaka weapon light and mount
* Blue Force Gear sling
* Custom cerakote finish

Again, this is one of the largest giveaways we’ve ever done, and it’s all thanks to YOU, Fellow Patriot.

This is our way of showing our appreciation to you for all the hard work you’ve put in over the past year.

**_Because of you, we’ve secured MULTIPLE recent wins like_** : \- A preliminary injunction against the ATF’s illegal ban on Forced Reset Triggers \- Halting the ATF’s pistol brace ban for NAGR members \- Stopping the New Mexico Governor from banning open and conceal carry in Albuquerque Those are just from the past few months!

But the work continues.

We will not rest until we see the Second Amendment stop being treated like a second-class right.

Again, I just wanted to say thank you one last time for all of your hard work, and you’re going to want to enter to win your **2023 Toyota Tacoma TRD Pro** AND a **custom cerakoted LWRC IC DI rifle** in our **2A Technical Giveaway** as quickly as possible!
| [ENTER TO WIN >>](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=yeh5rdalaxu3qnzzqzgk8wf6tw4q72gtutx6vhujsh2j2ctccjacsldl84nngvohtkpe95iduvdllnayvkndkix544b2nsc2rk4843ubvh2s1tj8en6sgh2dmcpsu56au4tb5tevwishcjg523j00rpkapfbg7s5xl7rodrj91v8q6iidh4y7k40osc8htj&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sd48kh)

God bless you, God bless America, and God bless our cherished freedoms.

**For Freedom,

Dudley Brown
President
National Association for Gun Rights**

Trump hosted a rally in Wisconsin at the Waukesha Expo Center. Joined by RPW Chairman Brian Schimming and others, President Trump highlighted the failures of the Biden Administration. The recent pro-Hamas demonstrations on the campus of UW-Madison were a major focal point of his remarks. This marked President Trump's second visit to Wisconsin in the last month. The WisGOP filed an amicus brief with the RNC and RITE PAC to protect Wisconsin's elections from illegal ballot drop boxes. This filing comes in response to efforts by the WisDems to circumvent court rulings prohibiting the practice. "The rule of law should not be undermined by Democrats attempting to overrule a case which was decided just two years ago," RNC Chairman Michael Whatley said. "Wisconsinites deserve a fair and secure election, not a rushed effort to throw out precedent and implement a system susceptible to dishonesty and fraud. The RNC and our partners are stepping up to protect voter confidence in Wisconsin."
---

In other election news, WisGOP Chairman Brian Schimming and WisDem Chairman Ben Wikler discussed the upcoming presidential and Senate elections in Wisconsin at a WisPolitics luncheon on April 26th.Chairman Schimming hammered home that the WisGOP will be proactive in turning out voters and utilizing every possible avenue to ensure maximum voter engagement. "We are not going to sit back and allow another party to take advantage of things that are legal and on the books," Schimming said. "We're not doing that; we're going for the win."
---

body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zg97s2gu5s2sk41d7n7ffc57ij01juna6aedjkl0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1jmap32clh2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqvj0otldf90b1qc4tg8bmvme1ujv3ojh589jd08_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1jmap32clh2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4m1l18ege17nir6h9u8o9kp2eh3adbitu3kr060_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1jmap32clh2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The Connection Between Faith and Freedom
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zcr3cfelfh375meso9klf5rh8677sdmegt364dd8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1jm6o31cdh2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zrdln2en6cguroutsns7g45jli1gir4o3dhahtm8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1jm6o31cdh2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zh324nei93k5lfrfp7cln7ou5dbf2185t18jpe4o_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1jm6o31cdh2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| 1600 Daily

There are positions up and down the ballot that will impact our lives as Hoosiers, so we encourage every Republican to get out and make sure your voice is heard. name: Riley Gaines
subject: Now they’re trying to erase all women.
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | Fellow Freedom Defender, Women no longer exist. That’s the Biden Administration’s endgame, and their changes to Title IX today take a devastating step towards it. For 52 years, Title IX has guaranteed the equal rights, protection, and access to the fruits of America’s prosperity for women. America’s public institutions guaranteed young women like me had access to equal and fair opportunities and could pursue our dreams of achievement and success unhindered. The Biden Administration ended those protections today. My fellow Leadership Institute graduate -- Congresswoman Virginia Foxx of North Carolina -- said, “This final rule dumps kerosene on the already raging fire that is Democrats’ contemptuous culture war that aims to radically redefine sex and gender.” Title IX used to protect against discrimination on the basis of sex -- on the incontrovertible, biological fact that men are men and women are women and both are afforded equal access under the law to government-funded programs. No more. The Biden Administration has rewritten the statute to base the protection not on sex but on “gender identity” -- a vague construction with no basis in science or common sense, but designed to push a harmful agenda. name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: National Referendum on Religious Liberty
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zevf4eai2ukonlo0hogdrpi2tljuaqrqr6rq5uk8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1jmeo76c5h2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z04v273k0ukukpf60agfj5enkmuli44n8lp6id0o_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1jmeo76c5h2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpjhjgdbf3q6dd926n0gl4alpm5cc4cesj12gt5g_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1jmeo76c5h2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

Most Americans know very little about America’s founding.

In today’s public schools, instead of learning about our Founding Fathers and the U.S. Constitution's principles, they are brainwashed with transgender ideology.

At The Heritage Foundation, we’re dedicated to creating conservative policy solutions that will defend and sustain our republic. But if our country is to survive, the American people must know our founding principles and the history that brought it about.

**That’s why my team at The Heritage Foundation is also committed to teaching the public about American history and our Founding Fathers.**

We published our _Founders' Almanac_ for this exact purpose.

subject: How important is religious liberty to you?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/aCXus_rskJ5Z1Z0Q6i8b7A~~/AARclAA~/RgRoHIPoP0SwaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0ItMjAyNDA1MDdXA3NwY0IKZjGz6jlmGAVd0VIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/aCXus_rskJ5Z1Z0Q6i8b7A~~/AARclAA~/RgRoHIPoP0SwaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0ItMjAyNDA1MDdXA3NwY0IKZjGz6jlmGAVd0VIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. ## Israel Strikes Rafah, Hamas Pushes Ceasefire
Israel began [military strikes on Rafah,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvpCAURn-NdhhAkJmCYhu72XZLc8GL3g0DBhjN_vuNL3nd605ymu87f17LCyhS2n7DG20LeQHf6MRFM8OkWlS_2oAocezRCiM0f2ihdb_bp5vCatQ4GfdUygXFjeZyAg7IhedTT1Zyqbjmhj_0JOQglA7Cj14F8XCTk53iuFLLZfibKbUdQ_yXTyyDz-8-2r21o3bjr07OnZyv6xqS8wmvevtOzjfeIpe4dnKOdCJzMW_f_DlWaFgZ1QIY2adsWJmnkyJBqiwinMgQasOSWIEAO_MIFVmggmzPBys-wf2Yi77Y9bgoRqqT6RTf3kDxa2f7Kdr_AAAA___sFm9a) Hamas' last major stronghold in Gaza, after warning civilians to evacuate. The move came hours after Hamas agreed to a ceasefire with mediators from Egypt and Qatar. Terms of the ceasefire weren't disclosed, but officials said it would [take place in stages](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQxvGnwRsRHGDTgaGLt3TtaB1wxFfh2DI0Ud--Sud-62_59P-8LlfkyvfbB24UetkXTJ0ftDg5SbCLHXIoREBmoKAn7ZR32rlhDWCNzpqQVDJa54w-QUwZcPKGksoDB1BglVOT8m7UcNHWFZ1MskX7OEYQVlHmvp-Xr53vfaVSf_YHnZe0b0MNa-9HE-ZdwCxgxuNOz_YiAXPlBwmYE2EjWfgkye1EqnLFDZv8PjJ2agKMek37Im2xReZkssToixzLWN4ixBcPZ8jHk2vlNk7CqtuGXP8-9P-C_AYAAP__v-lfsA), with Hamas releasing hostages it's holding in exchange for Israeli military pullbacks and the release of some Palestinian prisoners. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the ceasefire proposal was "far from Israel's demands" but that it would continue negotiation. Traditionally, Columbia has held graduation ceremonies on its main campus, but demonstrations have forced the May 15 event off campus with a series of smaller ceremonies. The latest $1,000 contempt fine was related to comments Trump made last month. The judge said Trump questioned the integrity of the proceedings by saying consisted mainly of Democrats. name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: How important is religious liberty to you?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/gmMcsf5eQ3xqIsfSYYuDGw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoHJI0P0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNTA3VwNzcGNCCmYzhfg5Zu78Kk9SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/gmMcsf5eQ3xqIsfSYYuDGw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoHJI0P0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNTA3VwNzcGNCCmYzhfg5Zu78Kk9SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/gmMcsf5eQ3xqIsfSYYuDGw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoHJI0P0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNTA3VwNzcGNCCmYzhfg5Zu78Kk9SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Restore Our Nation

name: Hillsdale College via Conservatives Give
subject: Religious Liberty is Under Serious Threat
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7d25d446dbb44f0f91a343a950a9c8ba&_e=nS2EAJ0F0DJJLOscmCgyzPK5Q5LWSNPTa4vNRTk72uxf9o8FT_IxarmGkoiB_s0QaAD21cUD2Cz2MHZhaeB1ILHO4sePKCXOCs-qZuq6rofc6865ZhkNJ3IhcU9p7XTvmkbx2kbJpxdrqftBSaqqEYY_abrnNSaMljUD5twqQW9AEgwiHOAhfdPr-w_gPXImoWfVvlVhR0RbI7jW6BIGhXmuyWGRRMHFmUZmwvpOhGLw_SHl-Yd1UqwDRXPVpla121VH7PhpeUHgIKdGuvCA9nvV3fWawRNS7QCgnHVdjkZ635y4KMqQccqC92_imlVywj4FANfxYIvkptZSS6xkoqH1nK1HD_sF8sH2X1h5i5Lo8w3WsLa8Cdj5l69vgZSy7XVVOo7sdfpCKfEz9CMIUA%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7d25d446dbb44f0f91a343a950a9c8ba&_e=nS2EAJ0F0DJJLOscmCgyzPK5Q5LWSNPTa4vNRTk72uxf9o8FT_IxarmGkoiB_s0QaAD21cUD2Cz2MHZhaeB1ILHO4sePKCXOCs-qZuq6rofc6865ZhkNJ3IhcU9p7XTvmkbx2kbJpxdrqftBSaqqEYY_abrnNSaMljUD5twqQW9AEgwiHOAhfdPr-w_gPXImoWfVvlVhR0RbI7jW6BIGhXmuyWGRRMHFmUZmwvpOhGLw_SHl-Yd1UqwDRXPVpla1U_oTp94VS1lHkj61H-bVQds72AXfG6c_9Kg0Br4MzdGQLCOmuyvSwOEgcPuByGM2_K9WZTetRdzZxRdOoeWyYOUhWZQB9Nepp8KOTpIB8l_4nEJsQZcLogkOvjReZoya_wUkeGDTlfMnZW2renIFPg%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7d25d446dbb44f0f91a343a950a9c8ba&_e=nS2EAJ0F0DJJLOscmCgyzPK5Q5LWSNPTa4vNRTk72uxf9o8FT_IxarmGkoiB_s0QaAD21cUD2Cz2MHZhaeB1ILHO4sePKCXOCs-qZuq6rofc6865ZhkNJ3IhcU9p7XTvmkbx2kbJpxdrqftBSaqqEYY_abrnNSaMljUD5twqQW9AEgwiHOAhfdPr-w_gPXImoWfVvlVhR0RbI7jW6BIGhXmuyWGRRMHFmUZmwvpOhGLw_SHl-Yd1UqwDRXPVpla1f-T4Xl4yQJjhxT4o1p47XAy2-68CD1dc2v2vLJRlFO250yTkd900VtZZspAM5JMnJAOsG2QNSCpRD7Bfa4H3gcxXh1XFhQN0eHlcXGvWMGuZpNKoNXF-LQ40a9C_9OTvZXkI_nQpVYUlbOBbySpCbw%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

It’s been clear for a long time that the Supreme Court has a corruption problem

| | | Peter, I’m running for re-election in Rhode Island for the United States Senate. [I’m hoping you’ll split a $10 donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action](https://default.salsalabs.org/T71d96515-7ff4-4984-8b7b-4bdf6c46dd98/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – and here’s why. It’s been clear for a long time that the Supreme Court has a corruption problem. I recently published a law review article highlighting how this captured Supreme Court often simply makes up false facts to arrive at decisions that ultimately benefit partisan Republican special interests. Take Citizens United v. FEC as an example. Remember when the Federalist Society justices said that all the unlimited political spending they were unleashing would be “transparent”? Well, we’ve seen dark money in politics prove them wrong several billion times over. Our system is designed to leave fact-finding to the lower courts that hear testimony, make credibility determinations, and review evidence. The Supreme Court is then supposed to defer to – and not alter – factual records in its decisions. Think about it: if the Highest Court in the Land makes up phony facts, there is nowhere else the parties can appeal to. The captured Roberts Court has done a lot of this phony fact-finding in big decisions that have fundamentally changed life in America. The Dobbs decision that ended a fundamental freedom for women is another one that was built on made-up history. How are the American people supposed to trust a Court that makes up its own rules to concoct decisions that suit right-wing special interests? [I won’t give up my fight to improve transparency and accountability at the Supreme Court, but I need your help. Split a contribution today to send me back to the Senate so I can protect American democracy and make sure our Court is giving Americans the fair shake they deserve.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3f7a2bb2-b330-47a2-ab5f-983d3f908d6e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect: after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t. When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families. Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 5/7/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks,
In case you missed the list of good and bad bills being discussed in the last week of assembly, [check out this article](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Check back into RMV for updates throughout the week! This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, May 7, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Retiring Republican Doug Lamborn endorses Jeff Crank as his replacement in Colorado's 5th CD ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Republican U.S. Rep. Doug Lamborn on Monday formally endorsed Republican Jeff Crank as his successor.

Calling the political operative and former talk radio host "a man of integrity, conviction and solid family values," Lamborn said he's throwing his "total endorsement and full support" behind Crank, one of two Republicans running for the El Paso County-based congressional seat Lamborn has held for nine terms.

Lamborn, who announced in January that he wouldn't seek reelection in the heavily Republican 5th Congressional District, said he decided to make the endorsement after watching the GOP primary unfold between Crank and Colorado GOP Chairman Dave Williams.

Both candidates have lost hard-fought primaries to Lamborn over the years: Crank in 2006 and 2008, when Lamborn won his first and second terms in Congress, and Williams in 2022, when Lamborn won his current term.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Adams, Arapahoe Republicans to jointly host 4th District forum Saturday in Bennett](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** **** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Six Republican candidates in the 4th District congressional race will participate in a [forum on May 11](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The forum aims to provide voters with an opportunity to engage directly with the candidates in an informal setting.
* The forum, co-hosted by [Adams and Arapahoe County Republicans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), will take place at Bennett Middle School. Scheduled to last two hours, the event starts at 3 p.m. with doors opening at 2:30 p.m.
* [Confirmed candidates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) include Lauren Boebert, Deborah Flora, Richard Holtorf, Michael Lynch, Jerry Sonnenberg, and Peter Yu; however, it will not feature candidates from the 4th District special election.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[GOP bill would force immigrants reported to ICE if they illegally try to buy guns](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **** [STRAIGHT ARROW NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Republican senators, led by Sen. Tom Cotton, introduced the [Illegal Alien NICS Alert Act](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), aimed at notifying immigration authorities when undocumented immigrants attempt to buy guns.
* Currently, the National Instant Criminal Background Check System (NICS) [doesn't alert ICE or local law enforcement](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) if a firearm applicant is in the U.S. illegally.
* According to Tillis' office, the FBI's database lists [14.8 million undocumented immigrants](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) banned from buying guns, with NICS having denied over 49,000 firearm purchases by undocumented immigrants since 1998.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**['There's vote-buying going on at a scale like we have never seen before'](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **** [POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* North Dakota Gov. Doug Burgum echoed former President Donald Trump's [allegations of widespread vote-buying](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), particularly pointing to President Joe Biden's student loan forgiveness efforts.
* Burgum, considered a potential vice-presidential pick for Trump, suggested that Biden's initiatives to relieve student debt could be seen as [pre-election payoffs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to secure votes.
* Previously part of the 2024 Republican presidential field, Burgum withdrew from the race but had implemented a campaign strategy of [rewarding individual donors with gift cards](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), aiming to address economic concerns attributed to "Bidenflation."

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado lawmakers OK bills on AI, oil and gas, medical malpractice](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado state House [debated and advanced several bills](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including ones addressing artificial intelligence (AI), oil and gas regulations, and medical malpractice liability.
* [House Bill 1468](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), aimed at broadening the scope of the state's facial recognition software task force to include the study of additional facets of AI and biometric technology, passed with a 37-24 vote. The bill now moves to the Senate.
* Senate Bills [229](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and [230](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), resulting from an agreement between Gov. Polis, environmentalists, and oil and gas companies, advanced in the House. SB 229 focuses on reducing oxides of nitrogen emissions from the oil and gas industry, while SB 230 imposes new fees on oil and gas operators to fund transportation initiatives.
* A bipartisan effort introduced [House Bill 1472](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to address liability lawsuits related to medical malpractice. The bill proposes increasing caps on damages for non-economic loss, wrongful death, and medical malpractice over several years, symbolizing a compromise between medical malpractice attorneys and insurance companies.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Walcher: We can govern ourselves, something our current regulators apparently no longer believe](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY GREG WALCHER** **| COMMENTARY | MAY 3** _There is a famous story about Nobel Prize-winning economist Milton Friedman walking down the street with a friend. The friend stopped and said, "Hey, there is a $20 bill on the sidewalk." The economist turned to him and replied, "There can't be. If there were a $20 bill on the sidewalk, somebody would have picked it up."_ __
**[Devotional:'It's not dying I'm talking about, it's living'](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)********BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | MAY 3** _Losing a loved one is one of the most painful experiences in life, especially when it happens in tragic circumstances. My friend, Delilah Maly, knows this pain all too well, after losing her son and my dear friend, Ethan Dow, on April 20, 2024. Ethan was only 22 years old and had so much potential, but he struggled with many issues in life. _ __
**[Barnhart: Abortion doesn't belong in Colorado's Constitution](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY FAYE BARNHART | COMMENTARY | MAY 2** _Colorado has one of the most extreme laws in the world. It allows children to be poisoned, scalded, stabbed, starved, dismembered or otherwise inhumanely killed by any means from all nine months of pregnancy up to the point of birth. To call these "procedures" to end the life of a living human being "healthcare" would be laughable were it not so barbaric and tragic.___

Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com?subject=Contributor%20Interest%20\(via%20Mountain%20Minute\)) or send us a message on social media to chat!
|
---
**🤔 DID YOU KNOW?** If you are looking for the mysterious, then you would love to know that there is a place in Colorado where an entire civilization vanished without a trace. Mesa Verde features an elaborate four-story city carved in the cliffs by the Ancestral Pueblo people between 600 and 1300 A.D. The mystery surrounding this ancient cultural landmark is the sudden disappearance of the thousands of inhabitants, who created the more than 4,000 identified structures.

SB 229 focuses on reducing oxides of nitrogen emissions from the oil and gas industry, while SB 230 imposes new fees on oil and gas operators to fund transportation initiatives. A bipartisan effort introduced to address liability lawsuits related to medical malpractice. The bill proposes increasing caps on damages for non-economic loss, wrongful death, and medical malpractice over several years, symbolizing a compromise between medical malpractice attorneys and insurance companies. | ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ BY GREG WALCHER | COMMENTARY | MAY 3 There is a famous story about Nobel Prize-winning economist Milton Friedman walking down the street with a friend. The friend stopped and said, "Hey, there is a $20 bill on the sidewalk." The economist turned to him and replied, "There can't be. If there were a $20 bill on the sidewalk, somebody would have picked it up." DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | MAY 3 Losing a loved one is one of the most painful experiences in life, especially when it happens in tragic circumstances. My friend, Delilah Maly, knows this pain all too well, after losing her son and my dear friend, Ethan Dow, on April 20, 2024. Ethan was only 22 years old and had so much potential, but he struggled with many issues in life. BY FAYE BARNHART | COMMENTARY | MAY 2 Colorado has one of the most extreme laws in the world. Dear Peter,
We are facing a critical challenge in our campaign to elect Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. as the next President of the United States.
[Time is running out, and we need your support to secure ballot access in Texas.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=texas_ballot_5_7_24_rs_nd1&n=3)
Texas presents a formidable obstacle for our campaign. The state's stringent ballot access requirements make it one of the toughest in the nation to qualify for the presidential ballot.
We have until May 13 to collect approximately 200,000 signatures to ensure Kennedy-Shanahan is on the Texas ballot!
This is where you come in!
We are racing against the clock to gather the necessary signatures and meet all the stringent requirements imposed by the state of Texas. We are mobilizing our supporters, volunteers, and resources to ensure we hit our goal.

subject: ☕Coffee w/ the Chairman
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE REPUBLICAN PARTY of NEBRASKA ()
body:
The Silent Majority

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/695d7ea82333/n41kepo7ku-12694044?e=25844e23a8)
https://ne.gop/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0da82141ea-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0da82141ea-21732365

** Good Morning Republicans,
------------------------------------------------------------
First off...Happy Mother's Day on Sunday! It is a day to celebrate the amazing way God created and gifted women with unique strengths and qualities. Proverbs 31:28 Her children stand and bless her. Her husband praises her:
Second...Tuesday, May 14th is our Primary. In 93 counties, Republicans will have the opportunity to be difference makers. Federal races to non-partisan legislative races, Board of Education to your local school boards, it's 1 of ONLY 2 times this year to make your VOICE heard. I know everyone is busy...work, planting season, school, sports, graduations, Mother's Day...but this is GO TIME!
Do you have a plan to VOTE? Does your County have plans to Get-Out-The-Vote (GOTV)? Can you make #OneMore call, text, email, Social Media post, letter to neighbor, or Coffee w/ a Friend to get a Republican to vote? When you go to church this weekend, WILL you remind everyone of their civic duty to vote?
EASY way to start the conversation on voting...don't ask WHO they are voting for...ask them HOW they are voting.
Otherwise...will you look back on May 15th and say "I should've" done more! Give everything you got this week to encourage Republicans to VOTE?
------------------------------------------------------------
The Silent Majority and Nebraska Nice culture are almost one in the same. The Silent Majority was a term used in a few political speeches, most notably by President Richard Nixon in a televised address on November 3, 1969. The Silent Majority is an unspecified large group of people in a country or state who do not express their opinions publicly, but have a clearly defined sense of principles and morality. Nebraska Nice was a tourism slogan in early 2014 promoting Nebraskans genuine niceness to visitors and avoidance of drama or attention seeking.
What is vastly misunderstood and severely dismissed is that the Silent Majority/Nebraska Nice people have a focused resolve like nothing this country has seen. I believe this large group represents the vast majority of Nebraskans. For most of them, it's now a spiritual conviction to follow a path driven to finding solutions within our government. They will naturally turn to the Political Party that MATCHES their values, has CREATED stability, and WELCOMES and VALUES them as equals. At the NEGOP, we have made unprecedented changes to the culture of our Republican Party and not only growing rapidly WITHIN Nebraska, other States seek to learn from us. From YOU! We are leaders in an America First movement. You have been measured, persistent, consistent, and striving to better yourselves everyday in this political landscape.
You have brought STABILITY to this party.
And I can guarantee you one thing...there HAS been an Awakening. This movement is built on People First. This is the area that I am most proud of and genuinely enjoy with my job as Chairman. Working together and watching the State and the vast majority of County Parties put the People First. More people, bringing more people, like a ripple in a pond and the numbers prove the results. Double the number of County Delegates attended this year's County Conventions. We've got more active parties and HUGE turnouts to county meetings all across Nebraska. And we are just scratching the surface of the potential within Nebraska's grassroots.
As I've said in other newsletters, I believe most Nebraskans are modest when it comes to politics. They would like to live the 'Good Life' devoid of politics and the ugliness, the distrust, the lack of character in some elected representatives. But after President Trump ignited a fire in many Americans, Modest Nebraskans began to look at the government differently. With the intentional chaos that ensued during 2020 and now 3.5 years of destructive National Democrat leadership, Modest Nebraskans had no choice but to become engaged to secure their very existence.
They realized something...
That by being silent as an electorate in essence condoned behavior by elected officials that didn't match the parties objectives or worse, didn't match the parties platform.
That by being silent as an electorate, the checks and balance to power had gone UNCHECKED at the local, State, and Federal level plus, the balance of power in the Political Parties had changed the narrative that a party only existed to serve POLITICIANS and not the people.
They realized that by being silent as an electorate, their voice was no longer viewed as relevant, outweighed by lobbyists and big donors AND their voice was being unconstitutionally, purposely suppressed to devalue it.
Nebraska Nice wasn't getting the job done in protecting their youth from social agendas.
Nebraska Nice wasn't getting the job done in finding real solutions to securing our elections.
Nebraska Nice wasn't getting the job done in reforming our massive tax codes.
Nebraska Nice wasn't protecting freedoms, human rights, and even our country.
This awakened majority normally would go about their business assuming that those in positions of governance and policy-making DESIRED to keep Nebraska...Nice.
This awakened majority believed that most elected officials could be taken at their word when campaign promises were transcribed on palm cards or proclaimed during campaign stops.
The awakened majority has realized that they are, in fact...the Majority! They have said, enough is enough to ineffectiveness. Enough is enough to moral gray areas and compromised principles that weaken our party. Enough is enough to "taxation without representation" and the demeaning REQUIREMENT of the working class as they PRODUCE the very wages to be TAXED and then other countries are FIRST. "Intel reports and briefings indicate this money will be well spent on a border between two countries, half way around the world, stopping ONE dictator."
What does the Intel report say about OUR own borders flooded with MILLIONS of illegal individuals?!? Wasn't that the point of all the visits TO the border (using tax payers dollars), with SELFIES taken and posting on social media, to gain INTEL for SOLUTIONS?
Today is a new day in Nebraska Politics especially for the Republican Party. This party has returned to serving its membership (The People), who support the objectives of the party, and the principles with which we represent. We CANNOT fear the new methodology of "We will campaign or legislate based on our principles and not bend to the agendas of today!" We have to STAND firm and not bow to the Liberal agendas because we don't want to hurt peoples feelings. We HAVE strong values that resonate with most Nebraskans. Folks, our challenges are not new and they are not unattainable. But they will require everyone in our party to see the Big Picture and work towards it together day-by-day. I believe that Nebraskans see the Big Picture when it comes to the immediate challenges we face as a State.
✅We have to fix Nebraska's broken property tax system
✅We have to prioritize election honesty that uses common sense and transparency of voting - Election Accountability and Voter Verification.
✅We have to grow our economy through job creation and education of work identities
✅We have to strengthen and maintain the amazing rural communities and modernize the infrastructures
✅We have to support our agricultural system, the lifeblood of Nebraska's economy
✅We have to restore educational basics, safety of classrooms, and the excellence of Nebraska values, so our kids take ownership of the Nebraska Good Life and stay IN Nebraska.
✅We have to bring respect to Law and Order and address the rising mental health concerns that can easily start in supporting healthy families.
DONATE (https://ne.gop/donate/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0da82141ea-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0da82141ea-21732365) to the NEGOP. DONATE to your local GOP.
We will put your dollars to work connecting to more Republican voters state-wide.
We will put your dollars to work defeating Democrats at the local level.

Our State Convention is May 18th (https://ne.gop/convention2024/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0da82141ea-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0da82141ea-21732365) and we have an awesome Featured Speaker - Lt. General Michael Flynn! We will be showing his movie "Flynn - Deliver the Truth. Whatever the Cost." on Friday night, May 17th including a Q&A session

FLYNN Movie Premiere Tour
Friday, May 17^th Lincoln, NE
5:00pm Doors open
5:00pm – 6:15pm Meet & Greet
6:30pm Movie starts

We have plenty of work to do with Legislation Support, support of candidates, connecting to coalition partners, event planning, and discussing the different committee's and groups need to be successful in 2024!
The truth shall set us free.
Blessings,
–Chairman Underwood

| | _**_Meet Tom Cotton_**_

Tom Cotton was born and raised on his family's cattle farm in Arkansas, served as an Army infantry officer in Iraq and Afghanistan, and is fighting for working Americans in the U.S. Senate.

The tragic attacks of September 11, 2001 occurred during Tom's final year of law school and changed his life's trajectory.

After clerking on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit and spending a short time in private law practice, he joined the United States Army as an Infantry Officer, spending nearly five years on active duty.

Between his two combat tours he served as a platoon leader with the Old Guard at Arlington National Cemetery, the unit responsible for military honors funerals.

Tom's military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal, Combat Infantry Badge, and Ranger Tab.

In the U.S. Senate, he's fighting the tough battles for Arkansans and Americans, and delivering real results. He knows that only the strong can survive in a dangerous world, and he's building a movement to make America strong again.
