body:
Do you support students taking universities hostage in solitary with Hamas? |
---

Fellow Conservative,

This is former Navy SEAL and current Montana U.S. Senate candidate Tim Sheehy.

I have run directly into enemy fire without regard for my life for my fellow servicemembers and Americans; I have played the role of a human shield. I have carried wounded teammates across the battlefield because I was trained never to leave a man behind–and I never will. _**I didn’t do any of this so that spoiled liberal arts students could spit on and burn the American flag in support of Hamas.**_****

We’ve all read and watched as far-left progressives on college campuses take their universities hostage in the name of humanitarianism and solidarity with the terrorist organization Hamas. We’ve watched them tear down Old Glory and replace it with the Palestinian flag.

It’s unconscionable.

**[We need to take action right now and fight back.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=dc1e648682644cbd9b69be5c012145c3&_e=kbknbaBjAUpqo-kGCFxyXbTSdEN-rpyG5dgt-AJOEMCRTte6HPaIwfNDtShNvLMH9jZKZ_PzsdiqJy_lyF8SmB6ikOI4RUNQKC_Sur73YGlH4mLTcxNthyFsLOQRHwLIy_ZyiW4LE2uAIV5HhMY3gt_dWF3GnWXRF1hg7sGHQHcGxOXbx4cEMEzyJnqjXd7IT5xYrKpGqhlak7RFKZW56wyO5OV4CNof7_3RIYlAS4Et-AOGeMV_BEcUsp185ClqSQ8n1fLBDMJv3NEaa7dkVtDwIt110rczjxoEpTYDr_KAlQ57rBVGNbqGO_4XXm0eJ2mCJJ1DMOhclF-BQ96N-addJEuXKsjTFlyPqdBtRU4OF9KGzezx4qskZt9tOVRw6sLjK50IBeNX4SQmYQNpaQ%3D%3D)** Please sign the petition and help send the loudest possible message to the liberal establishment and media in Washington: **We won’t stand for this pro-terrorist, anti-Israel lunacy.**

There is no room for error in an election as consequential as the one in front of us, so I’m contacting you today with a few questions I hope you’ll answer. **[
1. Do you support students taking universities hostage in solidarity with Hamas?

Hi folks.

Here’s a photo of my grandparents, Arnfred and Christine, on their wedding day in 1905. That was a couple years before they picked out a flat piece of grassland just outside Big Sandy to homestead.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84469126/471620135/1743277108?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3786-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYmViMWI4Yy03NDBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NI5xhgROWnWZyRdlsblkytq9xhHss-OQt3iJQ00GW6E=)
That patch of loamy, alkaline clay-soil is the same one where I grew up; where Sharla and I raised our kids, and where we still farm the land to this day.

Things weren’t easy for Fred and Christine. They suffered devastating windstorms, bitter cold, fires, poisonous snakes—pretty much everything but locusts. They had a couple hundred acres to their name, a newly-built barn, a windmill, their healthy son and daughters (including Helen, my mom), strong muscles, and the powerful work ethic that built rural America.

I first ran for office to make sure our government was serving hardworking Americans like my grandparents. Folks like our teachers, farmers, and construction workers deserve a government that fights for them.
But the special interests trying to unseat me don’t care about that. Dark money groups are spending millions of dollars to misinform voters and replace me with a mouthpiece for their own agenda. They’ll do whatever it takes to elect their handpicked candidate because they don’t care about protecting our way of life—they’re just in it for power and influence.

**That’s not how I operate, and it’s why we’re running this campaign differently. I’m counting on grassroots folks like you chipping in what you can, when you can, to build a team strong enough to take on the mountains of cash these outside groups have earmarked to defeat me.**

body:

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84470585/471624015/-822722586?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_TAN_AC90_20240507_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmViZTExMy03NjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H28B2SPt3l9D82-F-o_uP2UFsBhubA4uC1GEyXw4vZA=)

_Hey there, I wanted to pass along this message from my friend, Lucas Kunce, who's running for Senate in Missouri. _
* * *
Hi there, my name is Lucas Tyree Kunce and I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate. You know... This guy: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84470586/471624016/-725627645?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_TAN_AC90_20240507_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmViZTExMy03NjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H28B2SPt3l9D82-F-o_uP2UFsBhubA4uC1GEyXw4vZA=) | [CHIP IN TO DEFEAT HAWLEY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84470587/471624017/-725627645?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_TAN_AC90_20240507_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmViZTExMy03NjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H28B2SPt3l9D82-F-o_uP2UFsBhubA4uC1GEyXw4vZA=)
---
Further along in this email, I’m going to ask you to [**split a donation of any amount between my campaign and Nikki Budzinski****. ****But first, will you please give me just a few moments of your time to re-introduce myself?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84470588/471624018/-725627645?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_TAN_AC90_20240507_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmViZTExMy03NjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H28B2SPt3l9D82-F-o_uP2UFsBhubA4uC1GEyXw4vZA=)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84470589/471624019/-725627645?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_TAN_AC90_20240507_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmViZTExMy03NjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H28B2SPt3l9D82-F-o_uP2UFsBhubA4uC1GEyXw4vZA=)
I grew up in a working-class neighborhood in Jeff City. Like so many Americans, my parents lived paycheck-to-paycheck — so when my little sister was born with a heart condition, the medical bills bankrupted us. Maxed-out credit cards and no money left, we struggled to get by.
**But we weren’t alone.**
When my parents had to take my sister to get surgeries at a hospital over 100 miles away in St. Louis, our neighbors and friends took my siblings and me into their homes.
And when we couldn’t afford groceries, they brought more casserole and lasagna by the house than we could ever hope to eat.
**That’s the Missouri I grew up in.**
The support from our neighbors and friends motivated me to work hard, stay focused on school, and run on the cross-country team. After graduating from Jefferson City High School, I was able to get into Yale — which I could afford in part due to a Pell grant and scholarships from people around town.
I got to keep running at Yale, too.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84470591/471624020/-725627645?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_TAN_AC90_20240507_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmViZTExMy03NjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H28B2SPt3l9D82-F-o_uP2UFsBhubA4uC1GEyXw4vZA=)

**After undergrad and then law school at Mizzou, I joined the Marine Corps to honor and serve the community that had done so much for me. **
Less than a year after I completed training, I deployed to Iraq on my first of three tours of duty in the War on Terror, before later being stationed at the Pentagon.
During those 13 years of active duty I learned firsthand what service and sacrifice for your country really means: Doing the right thing when you’re thousands of miles from home, believing in a mission that’s bigger than yourself, and never forgetting the community you signed up to serve.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84470596/471624021/-725627645?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_TAN_AC90_20240507_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmViZTExMy03NjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H28B2SPt3l9D82-F-o_uP2UFsBhubA4uC1GEyXw4vZA=)
In Iraq, I deployed to the Sunni Triangle where I led a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman, running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi. From our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84470597/471624022/-725627645?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_TAN_AC90_20240507_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmViZTExMy03NjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H28B2SPt3l9D82-F-o_uP2UFsBhubA4uC1GEyXw4vZA=)
When I got back from living next to that burn pit, I had developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic.
They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits. Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
**So imagine how we all felt when politicians who had never worn the uniform, like Josh Hawley, threw us a giant middle finger and voted against aid for exposed veterans. **
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84470598/471624023/-725627645?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_TAN_AC90_20240507_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmViZTExMy03NjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H28B2SPt3l9D82-F-o_uP2UFsBhubA4uC1GEyXw4vZA=)
My final tour was on the Joint Staff at the Pentagon. There, I worked with the National Security Council, State Department, Department of Homeland Security, FBI, CIA, and other agencies to stop the proliferation of nuclear, chemical, and missile technology around the globe, to keep these weapons out of the hands of bad actors.
I spent every day doing what I could to make the world a safer place, with fewer arms, less chance of conflict, and more money to spend on improving lives rather than destroying them.
One of the hardest things for me between these tours was coming back home to Jeff City, to the community I had signed up to serve, and seeing what was going on in my old neighborhood.
When I came back from Iraq, the first house I’d ever lived in was bulldozed down. **Now, it’s an empty lot:**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84470600/471624024/-725627645?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_TAN_AC90_20240507_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmViZTExMy03NjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H28B2SPt3l9D82-F-o_uP2UFsBhubA4uC1GEyXw4vZA=)
When I came back from Afghanistan, the house I lived in when I joined the Marine Corps was vacant and starting to fall apart. The corner store was boarded up.
The whole time all of us were risking our lives overseas, our leaders were spending trillions of dollars trying to build up towns in these other countries — places like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat — when we should have been spending our money, blood, and sweat on towns like St. Joe, St. Louis, and Jefferson City.
From the Middle East to the Pentagon, my time in the Marine Corps provided me with direct insight into the control that giant corporations have over our tax dollars, our politics, and our everyday lives.
So after active duty, I joined the American Economic Liberties Project — the nation’s leading non-profit in the fight against monopoly power in our economy and our democracy. We took on the corrupt politicians and monopolists who dominate our lives, squeeze small businesses out of our markets, and enrich corporate elites at the expense of everyday Americans — from Big Tech and agribusiness conglomerates, to pharmaceutical cartels and defense contractors.
But now corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley don’t just attack our way of life, but the democracy I swore to defend.
Everyday people should be calling the shots in our country — not giant corporations or the cowards and phonies they bought off in Washington. That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate: To take power back for working families in Missouri and across America.
**And make no mistake about it, Missouri is on the frontline of this fight.**
While our state has been getting stripped for parts, politicians like Josh Hawley have been attacking workers with schemes like “Right-to-Work” and fighting to block wage increases for Missouri families — all to enrich multinational corporations and mega-donors who bankroll their campaigns.
As dozens of headquarters have been taken out of state, politicians in power like Josh Hawley were happy to sit back and watch it happen.
Manufacturing, agriculture, production — they’re shipping it all away to foreign oligarchs who don’t care about working people in our state. And while Missouri was getting gutted, these same politicians voted time and time again to spend trillions of dollars and thousands of lives on overseas wars that got their Big Oil friends rich.
They’ve spent decades sparking phony culture wars to distract and divide our families. They’ve become so obsessed with controlling our lives, they made Missouri the first state in the nation to ban abortion — without exceptions for victims of rape or incest.
**Our state deserves a Senator who will stand up and fight for it, not run for the exit like Josh Hawley. **
I’m running for U.S. Senate to be the warrior for working people that Missouri deserves — to fight like hell for our state and our people.
But to defeat Josh Hawley, we need to build a record-breaking, people-powered movement. That’s why I need your help.
**[We’re building a truly grassroots campaign, without a cent from corporate PACs, so we can stand up to the status quo and take back power for real working people across the state. So please, will you join our people-powered movement by splitting a donation of any amount between me and Nikki Budzinski today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84470602/471624025/-725627645?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_TAN_AC90_20240507_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmViZTExMy03NjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H28B2SPt3l9D82-F-o_uP2UFsBhubA4uC1GEyXw4vZA=)**

Changing The Rules In The Middle Of The Game | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/dbdbd9a8c141/conforti-for-congress-8400852?e=25f4fa3311)

| | |

| | | Dear Peter,

Once again, the Governor of Illinois has put politics before people.

In less than 48 hours, Bill 2412 was pushed through both state governing bodies and signed by Pritzker. This bill eliminates the ability of a party to slate candidates, reducing competition. And since only up to 3 advisory questions can be added to any ballot during the General Election, it states the 3 questions that will be on the ballot - bumping the peoples' efforts to add a Parental Rights question.

This is a direct snub to all parents across Illinois.

The Parents Matter Coalition has been working tirelessly to add a question on the November ballot that draws attention to a parents' right to be involved in their children's medical issues. Currently under new law, if a parent opposes medical treatment - vaccines, gender affirming surgery, etc., they can be imprisoned, and their kids taken away.

Pritzker has gone before the cameras stating this is an ethics issue. It is NOT. It is pure politics. The democrats were concerned with the strength of the movement the Parents Matter Coalition was leading to protect parental rights. In a move to squash those efforts, they enacted this bill and signed it into law within hours of the filing deadline for the Parents Matter advisory question to be placed on the ballot.

Our Rights are at stake, both locally and nationally. By supporting democrat policies such as these, Sean Casten is working against us in Congress. When I am in Congress, I will work to bring common sense back to the forefront and protect the constituents District 6, and all Americans.

You can help. Please consider making a donation to the campaign. Your contribution will go a long way in helping us win! Click the link below to make a donation today.

[](https://conforti4congress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fd34b7284bf7f5e87a4e45e5&id=57a1321b4b&e=25f4fa3311)

Your support is greatly appreciated.
---
| Thank you,

Niki Conforti

Illinois 6th Congressional District

clean_body: Changing The Rules In The Middle Of The Game | | | | | | | | | | Dear Peter, Once again, the Governor of Illinois has put politics before people. In less than 48 hours, Bill 2412 was pushed through both state governing bodies and signed by Pritzker. This bill eliminates the ability of a party to slate candidates, reducing competition. And since only up to 3 advisory questions can be added to any ballot during the General Election, it states the 3 questions that will be on the ballot - bumping the peoples' efforts to add a Parental Rights question. This is a direct snub to all parents across Illinois. The Parents Matter Coalition has been working tirelessly to add a question on the November ballot that draws attention to a parents' right to be involved in their children's medical issues. Currently under new law, if a parent opposes medical treatment - vaccines, gender affirming surgery, etc., they can be imprisoned, and their kids taken away. Pritzker has gone before the cameras stating this is an ethics issue. It is NOT. It is pure politics. The democrats were concerned with the strength of the movement the Parents Matter Coalition was leading to protect parental rights. In a move to squash those efforts, they enacted this bill and signed it into law within hours of the filing deadline for the Parents Matter advisory question to be placed on the ballot. Our Rights are at stake, both locally and nationally. By supporting democrat policies such as these, Sean Casten is working against us in Congress. When I am in Congress, I will work to bring common sense back to the forefront and protect the constituents District 6, and all Americans. You can help. Friend,
We knew the TV attack ads were coming—we just didn’t think it would happen so soon.
Last week, one of our Republican opponents released an attack ad against Elissa. And as of yesterday, he is up on broadcast TV across Michigan introducing himself to voters across the state and attacking one of our Republican opponents.
The ads came from GOP Senate candidate Sandy Pensler, a businessman worth *at least* $80 million. He ran for senate back in 2018 and spent more than $5 million dollars of his own money—so we know he’s willing and able to flood the airwaves with a barrage of lies about Elissa.
Pensler’s campaign has already placed nearly $1 million in TV ads through May, and he has told the press that he intends to stay on TV until the August 6 primary. Pensler will introduce himself to voters across the state, and he is saying he is going to attack his Trump-endorsed primary opponent, Mike Rogers, in what is shaping up to be a MESSY primary on the GOP side.
Pensler’s TV efforts are a significant investment in our race and shift the calculus of our own major spending decisions.
With attack ads already airing on TV and in social media, we know we are looking down the barrel of a multi-million dollar campaign to attack Elissa’s reputation and influence the outcome of our election.

We thought you may be interested to receive this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=4753a55637-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

Former President Trump speaks at a Republican National Committee donor retreat, on May 4, 2024, in Palm Beach, Florida. (Donald Trump 2024 campaign)

By Illinois Review

On Saturday, President Donald Trump hosted a private event at his Palm Beach estate Mar-a-Lago with top Republican donors for the Republican National Committee’s Spring Retreat – as officials announced raising a staggering $76 million last month as Trump – who leads in virtually every national poll and in key swing states – takes on President Joe Biden in an election rematch this November.

Guests at the retreat included the country’s top Republican political leaders – including House Speaker Mike Johnson, who’s third in line to the presidency. And during his speech, President Trump invited several leaders to the stage and introduced each of them individually. Joining him alongside Johnson were U.S. Senators Marsha Blackburn, Mike Lee, Marco Rubio, Tim Scott, JD Vance and Doug Burgum; U.S. Representatives Jim Banks, Byron Donalds, Wesley Hunt, Elsie Stefanik and Michael Waltz; candidates Dave McCormick and Bernie Moreno; former presidential candidate Vivek Ramaswamy, RNC chairman Michael Whatley and RNC co-chairwoman Lara Trump.

The lineup on stage also included a surprise guest – former Democratic Illinois Gov. Rod Blagojevich – who Trump invited to the stage last minute. The former governor has been busy raising money for the Trump campaign. On February 18, 2020, President Trump commuted Blagojevich’s prison sentence after having served 8 years of a 14-year sentence for routine political dealmaking. The former governor never took a dime – and no one even alleges he took any money – he was simply exploring political deals as he weighed making an appointment to fill Obama’s vacant U.S. Senate seat after he was elected president. The former governor was targeted by the same
political enemies (https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/opinion/1493869/how-robert-mueller-and-james-comeys-best-friend-sent-rod-blagojevich-to-prison/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=4753a55637-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) going after Trump, including former FBI Director Robert Mueller and James Comey’s best friend Patrick Fitzgerald.

Blagojevich Joins Trump, Speaker Johnson and GOP Officials on Stage During RNC Retreat at Mar-a-Lago Over the Weekend () Former President Trump speaks at a Republican National Committee donor retreat, on May 4, 2024, in Palm Beach, Florida. (Donald Trump 2024 campaign) By Illinois Review On Saturday, President Donald Trump hosted a private event at his Palm Beach estate Mar-a-Lago with top Republican donors for the Republican National Committee’s Spring Retreat – as officials announced raising a staggering $76 million last month as Trump – who leads in virtually every national poll and in key swing states – takes on President Joe Biden in an election rematch this November. Guests at the retreat included the country’s top Republican political leaders – including House Speaker Mike Johnson, who’s third in line to the presidency. And during his speech, President Trump invited several leaders to the stage and introduced each of them individually. Joining him alongside Johnson were U.S. Senators Marsha Blackburn, Mike Lee, Marco Rubio, Tim Scott, JD Vance and Doug Burgum; U.S. Representatives Jim Banks, Byron Donalds, Wesley Hunt, Elsie Stefanik and Michael Waltz; candidates Dave McCormick and Bernie Moreno; former presidential candidate Vivek Ramaswamy, RNC chairman Michael Whatley and RNC co-chairwoman Lara Trump. The lineup on stage also included a surprise guest – former Democratic Illinois Gov. Rod Blagojevich – who Trump invited to the stage last minute. The former governor has been busy raising money for the Trump campaign. On February 18, 2020, President Trump commuted Blagojevich’s prison sentence after having served 8 years of a 14-year sentence for routine political dealmaking. The former governor never took a dime – and no one even alleges he took any money – he was simply exploring political deals as he weighed making an appointment to fill Obama’s vacant U.S. Senate seat after he was elected president. The former governor was targeted by the same political enemies () going after Trump, including former FBI Director Robert Mueller and James Comey’s best friend Patrick Fitzgerald. Dear Friend, Populism is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think about American politics as being divided between the Left and the Right, the reality is much different.

| | Dear Friend,Populism is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think about American politics as being divided between the Left and the Right, the reality is much different. What we’ve really been seeing is two sets of populist backlash against both the Democrat and Republican establishment.
---
| [](http://trk.libertyledger.)
---
| | And believe it or not, these tensions actually trace their roots back to Roman times.

That’s why I’m sending you this email today.

I want to make sure you get a free copy of one of our popular eBooks: **[Dueling Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson](http://trk.libertyledger.-u0lDa0_bWNYCAA)**.

Hanson is a Hoover Senior Fellow and world-renowned historian, and I think you’ll get a lot out of his insights. Inside this important eBook, you’ll learn more about:
* What we can expect from a political climate ruled by movements that rebel against both the establishment—and each other.
* The important parallels between these ancient movements and their modern counterparts in both progressive and conservative populism.
* What lies ahead for America as we revive these ancient tensions in our culture.

You can get your free copy of Dueling Populisms using this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/dueling-populisms-signup/](http://trk.libertyledger.)**.

And please feel free to share this with your family and friends. It’s important that we recall the voices of experience and apply them to contemporary conflicts and challenges.

You can use this link to get access to your free eBook right now.
Thanks,Greg Greg Stamps | Online DevelopmentHoover Institution | Stanford University

# Down to the Wire!
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=4342809237&e=0a12281e0e)
📢 Attention MD-06 Voters! We’re down to the wire with just 7 days left until the Republican Primary on May 14th. Your vote matters! 🗳️ Early voting ends May 9th, and the day of the election is May 14th. Don’t miss your chance to secure your vote for Republican Candidate Mariela Roca today!
Find your day of polling location here ⬇️[Sea](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=598d92ef8c&e=0a12281e0e)
[CLICK HERE TO FIND YOUR POLLING LOCATION](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=283fff72cd&e=0a12281e0e)
# Voting Numbers Today
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=840c4b5e0e&e=0a12281e0e)
We're thrilled to see such a strong turnout of 10,891 Republicans having already cast their votes in the Republican primary election as of today!
What's truly encouraging is that 95% of these individuals have had some interaction with our team—whether it's receiving a friendly mailer, a thoughtful postcard, a quick text, or a door knock.
It's all about spreading our message and connecting with voters on a personal level. With this kind of support, we're feeling pretty confident that our message is resonating with voters as we gear up for the big day on May 14th! 🇺🇸
# Fundraising
I know that many of you have already helped our campaign out so much, and many of you have not been able to contribute monetarily due the the economically challenging times we are all facing. I truly believe the future of our district and country is at stake, and I KNOW we can win this nomination with your help through this last push. I have skin in the game as I have also contributed some of my personal funds for this effort. And I really hate to ask you for monetary help, but I need your help now more than ever.
Every dollar you contribute will bring us one step closer to ensuring a Republican victory in November for Maryland 6th, one of the most crucial races in the country that can decide our House Majority!
Please click on the link below to make your secure contribution TODAY:
[**https://secure.winred.com/roca-for-congress/donate**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=e10796053d&e=0a12281e0e)
The future of our Republican majority in the House of Representatives hangs in the balance. We cannot afford to lose sight of the importance of securing seats like Maryland's 6th Congressional District if we want to keep a Republican majority in the House of Representatives. 🇺🇸
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=eeaad73e51&e=0a12281e0e)
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=18dcb560a0&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for Congress MD-06U.S. Air Force Veteran
|
---
# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=8130e8c831&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=09282001b1&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b0e1b5a304&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=21edc63932&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=3982962281&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2501b68a68&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=ad366bdb20&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=29e98e5573&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=d927e5d203&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=dab4837609&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2dc7829402&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=dbafb9a3e2&e=0a12281e0e)
|

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsrdrTgiNl

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osrdrTgiNl

Friends,

Not long
ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and
sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored?
There will be no censorship of humor."

We've
been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since.

But as
resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still
just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the
law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by
Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of
months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz
Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a
talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of
that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more
emphatically than I ever could, they censored my talk about
censorship.

It's
clear to us that what the censors want is submission. They want
unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start
fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want
to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather
just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties.
They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to
make things easier.

Our
answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth
more than whatever they can take from us.

Of
course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the
censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The
Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we
did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our
subscribers.

That's
our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back
against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of
business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and
smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our
supporters to thank for that. I hope you'll consider joining the
fight by becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.

But don't
just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find
them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and
subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say
what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes
at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much
harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving
subscribers at their backs.

YES,
I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE

Thanks
for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you.

Sincerely,
Seth
Dillon
CEO, The
Babylon Bee

mailing address is:
The

Dear friend,
We had a jam-packed week on the campaign trail. Rob was all over the District visiting local small businesses and discussing some of the economic challenges they face under Biden and Cartwright. We are beyond thankful to Don’s Machine Shop, Metamorphosis Hair Salon, For Your Health Medical Supply, and Bovino’s Brewery for having us!
[](https://robforpa.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4aaa9665caa590d8638bb435d&id=208ba688b0&e=131e83a3c2)
|
---
Rob was invited to speak with a local FOP lodge in Lackawanna County and connect with some of our brave men and women in law enforcement. He has seen the important work done by our men and women in law enforcement and is proud to know we have the nation’s finest law enforcement organization protecting us.
|
---
On International Firefighters Day, Rob had the opportunity to speak with the brave men and women of the Shavertown Volunteer Fire Department. These folks volunteer their time to run into burning buildings and save lives, and they deserve a Congressman who will have their backs. It was also great to see the next State Representative for HD 120, Brenda Pugh, at the Kids’ Fishing Day Derby at Frances Slocum State Park and to walk in the West Pittston Cherry Blossom Parade with Mayor Alfano.
|

I received a death threat from Beijing because I love Liberty, Freedom, and the United States of America. More on that in a minute.

Right now, I want to introduce myself.

_My name is Lily Tang Williams, and I fled Communist China and escaped the evil Communist indoctrination. I'm running for Congress because I fear the country I love is becoming like the country I left._

You see: I was born to illiterate working-class parents in China's western Sichuan province just before Mao's Cultural Revolution. I grew up in extremely poor living conditions with food rationing, social chaos, and indoctrination into Communism.

At a young age, I learned a hard lesson about surviving in a Communist regime: conform and keep your thoughts private. Do not trust anyone, even your friends.

Everything changed when an American exchange student showed me a pocket-sized version of "The Declaration of Independence." Even with my limited English skills, I could understand most of these words: "We hold these truths to be self–evident...." It's like a lightbulb came on. I had never heard such beautiful words before, and I loved them so much that I spent many hours with my American friend to learn more about these new concepts and America.

_**I had a new dream: I wanted to go to America.**_

In 1988, I made it to America with only $100 in my pocket, which I borrowed, along with a $1,200 loan from my sponsor. I spoke very little English. In the 33 years since I have enjoyed living in this great country. I received a graduate degree, got married, raised three children, started my own business, and was naturalized as a U.S. citizen in 1995.

Fast forward to today: I've spoken out against Communism and Socialism appearing on Fox News, Tucker Carlson Tonight, Fox Business, Newsmax, Timcast, Huckabee TV, John Stossel, Joe Pags Show, Gothix TV, Shawn Ryan Show, Epoch Times TV, and Glenn Beck Radio.

I've authored opinion articles for The Epoch Times, Town Hall, National Review, Union Leader, Concord Monitor, and Granite Grok.

_And here's where the death threats from Beijing started: when I decided to run for Congress._

The Democrats don't want my story to reach the ears of my fellow Americans because they hope to enact their Socialist Agenda.

But more importantly, you and I cannot afford to let the woke liberal elite plunge the America we know and love any further down the dark path of Communism and trample on our God-given rights.

_Believe me. I'm not fear-mongering when I say you cannot imagine the horrors of Socialism and Communism. It is evil._

**[That's why I need you to stand with me and preserve the freedoms and values of our American heritage.](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=bb5e23ac4e49401eac476ef10df1c94a&_e=WpC_pAIjMDGMXneptIWIJydjSxP1sB_7q9tCUwxsoHPwKtEGuwyFINY2ZEue83qazTYwNNUU0dpnTfl1i-pXjj1YvJBAu6rS9HJ_1uCTwnqZZHxIYTaN31wdirzSFs-stUqnZtan3W3b1rMj8uwfoDcvBs8P4T7mpADBPSKrAmW-CAOxh_S3T0hZCJQpH1q7VfqbAbGISV--YqT7C8U5c7SbZye9Y3bbn4Tdikg0ga3dLl2NGoAMozBxbPdgbGWf5m9mM_L6eHW7FiLZOh1_DQmC2YMteCbQ0X9zh52MisZBWOIN18tgqut10vTnXxqQXeaazQyyYuNYOOl3kOPBT3COyQNb9KLjHJAIrIR-itEr-5r5gJbDV1X6cDc-ApaZoNbl-R6PpTeoJ3Ma3euznWWTyQRkum3XrF00PruF_kA%3D)**

For freedom,
Lily Tang Williams

subject: I’m a fighter

body:
Friend, my motto has always been that when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work. That's what I'm doing every day in the Senate.
I'm fighting for the Dignity of Work . No matter where you're from or what kind of work you do, hard work should pay off for everyone. Whether you punch a clock or swipe a badge, earn a salary or make tips, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I'll fight for you.
I'm fighting for accountability. For years, we've seen corporations lobby for tax breaks and bad trade deals that hurt workers. I'm not afraid to stand up to Wall Street or take on Big Pharma to level the playing field.
I'm fighting for our fundamental rights. My opponent has made it clear he doesn’t have our best interests at heart. I will always fight for a more equal and inclusive country.
But here's the deal, friend: I need you to fight with me. I'm facing my toughest race yet, and polls show me neck and neck with my Trump-backed opponent. He’s spending millions of dollars to flip this seat and the Senate red, and I can't fight back without your help.
I need to raise $50,000 by midnight tonight to fight back, and I'm counting on your grassroots support to get there. Please, will you split a $20 donation between my campaign and Serve America to help me win in Ohio, defend our Democratic Senate majority, and keep fighting for you in the Senate? Thank you,
Sherrod

Well, let me tell you, as someone who’s seen it up close: you’re right. _**Way too many**_ people in Congress seem focused on saying or doing the most outrageous thing possible in order to get attention. But I hear all the time from folks here in Oregon how sick everyone is of that approach. That’s one of the reasons I ran for Congress in the first place — and it’s why I do things differently. For me, this job is about delivering results. I’m proud to be one of the only representatives to actually get a law passed through this dysfunctional Congress last year — an important one to ensure that the Grand Ronde Tribe here in Oregon gets land compensation they are owed by the federal government. I’ve also delivered over $14 million in federal funding for vital community projects across OR-06 — from improving access to clean drinking water in Independence to expanding broadband access in Sherwood. And I’ve worked across the aisle, with both Democrats and Republicans, on legislation to improve access to mental health care, support our agriculture sector, and make housing more affordable for working families. [_**I’m making a bet that this is the kind of leadership people want — leadership that puts people over politics, and solutions over empty sound bites. | The Department of State Health Services, essentially our state’s public health agency, recently held a public hearing about its budget requests for the 2026-27 fiscal years. Texas spends billions of dollars every two years to fund various local and statewide programs, including vaccine administration for children and adults. Notably, an unknown amount of taxpayer money is spent each year on the antiquated vaccine exemption process. Currently, a parent or college student must request exemption affidavits through an online DSHS portal, which requires Texans to disclose personal information like full name, date of birth, and home address. DSHS then prints and mails each affidavit; in fiscal year 2022, this amounted to hundreds of thousands of dollars spent on specialty cardstock paper, ink, envelopes, postage, and labor. TFVC Political Director Michelle Evans took advantage of the hearing to provide testimony about a legislative solution to this unnecessary abuse of taxpayer funds - allow Texans to print exemptions at home. She also called on DSHS to join TFVC in the effort to advocate for this statutory fix.

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | The Department of State Health Services, essentially our state’s public health agency, recently held a public hearing about its budget requests for the 2026-27 fiscal years. Texas spends billions of dollars every two years to fund various local and statewide programs, including vaccine administration for children and adults. Notably, an unknown amount of taxpayer money is spent each year on the antiquated vaccine exemption process. Currently, a parent or college student must request exemption affidavits through an online DSHS portal, which requires Texans to disclose personal information like full name, date of birth, and home address. DSHS then prints and mails each affidavit; in fiscal year 2022, this amounted to hundreds of thousands of dollars spent on specialty cardstock paper, ink, envelopes, postage, and labor. TFVC Political Director Michelle Evans took advantage of the hearing to provide testimony about a legislative solution to this unnecessary abuse of taxpayer funds - allow Texans to print exemptions at home. The world's biggest innovation stage just got a dose of Forward

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_ted_talk_email&n=1)

Tuesday, May 07, 2024 | Peter -- We've got some big news! Forward Party co-founder Andrew Yang took to the stage this year at TED2024. His Talk is now live—you can watch the whole thing here: | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=2Uk3WzuKKFq0C5pu0SkUe5sWF74xglwmo-CvOWApsNU&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_ted_talk_email&n=2 "Watch the TED Talk") [Watch the TED Talk](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=2Uk3WzuKKFq0C5pu0SkUe5sWF74xglwmo-CvOWApsNU&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_ted_talk_email&n=2)
---
Andrew spoke to some of the biggest innovators and entrepreneurs in the world to outline the changes that our democracy _**needs**_ _._ It's no surprise that partisanship is on the rise while trust in our institutions has hit an all-time low. But Andrew doesn't just highlight the reasons why this is happening. He also offers solutions to these problems in this insightful speech.
Here are just a couple highlights to share:
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=2Uk3WzuKKFq0C5pu0SkUe5sWF74xglwmo-CvOWApsNU&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_ted_talk_email&n=3)
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=2Uk3WzuKKFq0C5pu0SkUe5sWF74xglwmo-CvOWApsNU&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_ted_talk_email&n=4)
We know how to address the problems, and we know that our current system isn't working for us. What we need now is to find the political will and create the movement to make the changes we need.
So [share this TED talk with your friends and family](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=2Uk3WzuKKFq0C5pu0SkUe5sWF74xglwmo-CvOWApsNU&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_ted_talk_email&n=5). Let them know that the issues with our system can be fixed, if we the voters show up to the polls and demand that our leaders address them. The Forward Party is building a nationwide movement to ensure that such leaders are elected, and we who want to get America back on the right track are building the infrastructure needed to make this change happen.
All we need to do is decide, together, to do the work creating the America we want to live in. Join us, and help move America #Forward.
Best,
Forward Party

| | **Bill Eigel's Letter to the GOP**
---
| | Tuesday, May 7, 2024 ATTN: Nick Myers Missouri Republican Party 514 E High St #31 Jefferson City, MO 65101 Dear Chairman Myers, I call on the Missouri Republican Party (MRP) to recall the state convention for the purpose of completing a new 2024 GOP Platform as soon as a practical time and place can be determined and prior to the 2024 National Republican Convention. The reason for the early adjournment of the state convention lies squarely in the hands of MRP Chairman Nick Myers, who delayed the proceedings of the convention, for reasons unknown, for more than 5 hours. Although it is unclear exactly why Chairman Myers delayed the convention for so long—it is clear that such a delay forced the proceedings well into the evening where an absence of quorum occurred, ending the proceedings. The vote for permanent convention chair, which finally occurred in the mid-afternoon, was the turning point of the convention. Chairwoman Shore managed more than 800 delegates through all orders of business and over thirty amendments to the platform in less time than Chairman Myers needed to simply count the number of delegates in the room. During the platform, convention delegates approved amendments to the 2024 Platform that included protecting Missouri land from foreign entities, eliminating personal property tax, deporting illegal immigrants, and getting rid of the Joe Biden voting machines infecting our elections. Due to the egregious delay at the hands of the MRP, the convention ended without the adoption of the 2024 Platform. Unless MRP owns its mistakes and recalls the delegates to finish their work, the voices of millions of Republicans excited about this bold, conservative policy direction will be silenced. The clear message from convention was this: The GOP convention delegates were deeply disappointed in the status quo. They voted against the establishment at every opportunity, the “Truly Grassroots for Trump” slates all won, and they would have passed the most conservative platform vision the state has ever seen if Chairman Myers wouldn’t have taken five hours to credential the delegates. The MRP must recall the state convention to finish the Platform work as soon as possible. Previous Platforms—from 2020 or otherwise—do not reflect the current emphasis of policy for Missouri Republicans and are not acceptable.
The message of the 2024 GOP State Convention to the establishment was loud and clear: **Do not ignore us. Do not silence us any longer.**
Let’s Go, Missouri. Respectfully, Bill Eigel Delegate Congressional District 3

body:

body:

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, MAY 7
GREATER GEORGIA CHAIRWOMAN KELLY LOEFFLER APPLAUDS SIGNATURE OF NEW ELECTION BILLS
(ATLANTA) - Today, Greater Georgia Chairwoman and former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler applauded Governor Kemp as he signed a package of new election integrity bills into law. The package features several key pieces of legislation, including [Senate Bill 189](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001IrANbfTDoplf5URaxjMbaq5iWiajd0cOYQDG-W3d_7pE9KMnvnOkbzqgbXbjOlwIWRTSWhQxoVcXvEYudErCk6aG6yViZopfMzHFFajAJMqTKEzMFwgjYyTNgLoppxf4mHk15NcaHnSvED1RZzwKHROd2gOE-sC4bM-3Z71euV_v_e1lq4nLxg==&c=yn9eODGKrsvWilF3x96MQyMSR13x74jyRn2qo8TQEH7W2VNSvztzlg==&ch=pHbTMXNSTH5jmMVgCRmfRBB1n4xbF24B8VGoodo3lKOlBkQiaQ5Ixg==) \- which codifies some of the most significant election reforms of 2024.
"Greater Georgia is grateful to Governor Kemp for signing today's package of election reforms - and to our conservative leaders, including Lt. Governor Jones and Speaker Burns, who have made continuous investments in election integrity, year after year," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "Although there is always more work to be done, our new laws will ensure even more accuracy, safety, and transparency. On the eve of a presidential election, Georgians deserve to have confidence that - despite the best efforts of liberal activists in our courts, our media, and our federal government - their votes will count. That's why Greater Georgia will continue to be a watchdog for election integrity."
Senate Bill 189 expands on the previous reforms of SB 202, Georgia's Election Integrity Act, which was passed in 2021. Among other provisions, the new law:

* Removes the Secretary of State from the State Election Board to promote impartiality in Board deliberations.
* Expands the conditions for challenging and removing ineligible voters from the voter rolls to ensure only legal, eligible citizens can vote.
* Sets clear deadlines for submitting absentee ballots.
* Allows a political party's presidential candidate to qualify for Georgia's ballot if they have obtained ballot access in 20 other states.
* Bans Secretary of State employees from obtaining state contracts related to voting equipment, preventing conflicts of interest.
* Creates additional ballot chain of custody rules starting in 2025 to prevent tampering or misplacement of absentee ballots.
* Eliminates QR codes from ballots starting in 2026 so that only human-readable inputs are counted when tabulating vote totals.

Senate Bill 189 was sponsored by State Senator Max Burns (R-Sylvania) and carried in the State House by Representative John LaHood (R-Valdosta).

name: Andrew Yang
subject: My TED Talk is Out!
body:
| |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=d1ca91ed73&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
Great news – my [TED Talk](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=6fdec31d97&e=0f227c2ae3) came out today! I’m pumped to have it out in the world as I believe it could be the best case made yet to the biggest audience for a different approach to curing American politics.

---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=70b6201aa4&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
Every day we are bombarded by messages about how divided and polarized we are – yet there is a real and concrete path to improve the incentives to make America more rational right now.

I open my talk with why American politics are so dysfunctional and why the incentives are so corrupted, and then break down how the changes made to the primary elections in Alaska in 2020 led to better processes and outcomes just two years later. Making similar changes to the primaries in 5 to 10 other states would cost only 2% of what the 2 parties are going to spend this year inflaming and aggravating us. How much is being spent to bring us back together or improve the system? This is the highest-leverage way to solve the biggest problems facing humanity: only by making our government’s incentives rational can we make progress on addressing poverty, climate change, AI and other major challenges.

If you have 10 minutes you can watch the TED Talk [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=f12e851119&e=0f227c2ae3). I hope you agree that it’s worth sharing. Please do forward it to friends and family who would have an interest – let’s get the numbers up and spread the word! If you’re on social media please amplify it as well. There are two places the talk will likely be viewed: on TED’s website and on YouTube.

I’ll confess that it’s my hope that this talk will unlock new resources for the movement. For people in the fortunate position to fund ballot initiatives, [Unite America](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=cd658496da&e=0f227c2ae3) is aggregating funds right now. To join the reform movement, consider joining the [Forward Party](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=a732940031&e=0f227c2ae3), or as I call it in my talk, “Team Overhaul the Incentives.”

TED’s tagline is “Ideas Change Everything.” Can a video seen by millions catalyze real change? Let’s find out. Hope you’re as excited about this way to get the message out as I am!
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party
[forwardparty.com](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=cd19d418db&e=0f227c2ae3)

Friend,

Today, I am reaching out with an urgent call to action–one that will undoubtedly shift the balance of power in the Senate and give Republicans a fresh, strong voice in New Mexico.

Of course, I’m talking about my friend **Nella Domenici** , a true fighter running for Senate in New Mexico. Nella represents the very best of our values and is committed to service and delivering results for the people of the Land of Enchantment.

I am proud to lead these efforts and help Conservatives WIN BIG up and down the ballot. These efforts will not only allow us to confront bad actors and stop cheating but will help our Party appeal to younger voters and swing-state independents.

There's just one problem: campaign operations like these are EXPENSIVE. It's not cheap running ads, printing flyers, recruiting volunteers, and expanding voter contact efforts.

Our country’s AANHPI community includes over 45 ethnicities and more than 100 language dialects, and continues to be the fastest growing ethnic group in the United States. **As the first Asian American woman elected to the Senate — and the only immigrant currently serving in the chamber — I have never been more aware of the importance of representation.** For most of my career, I engaged in this work stolidly and without much fuss. In the cultures I was raised in, we were not rewarded for speaking up, or speaking out. So I focused on doing the work, and letting the work speak for itself. This led many to say, when I began speaking out about the awful actions by the Trump Administration, and the awful behavior by Trump himself, that I had “found my voice.” **This could not be further from the truth. I chose to use my voice.** I couldn’t stand by while the Trump administration ripped children out of the arms of their parents, incited white supremacists, and packed the nation’s courts with demagogues who would later overturn _Roe v. Wade_. His bullying behavior, and his interest in tearing our country apart by our differences, instead of investing in the diversity that makes us stronger, had to be called out. This interest in exposing our differences was never limited to Donald Trump. This is the GOP’s agenda. It was there in the way they embraced calling COVID-19 “the China virus,” it was there when they spoke out against President Biden’s intention to nominate a Black woman to the Supreme Court, and it is still there now, as they stonewall Julie Su, an Asian American woman immigrant nominated to serve as Secretary of Labor. **As long as Republicans — whether in the House, the Senate, or the supermajority of right wing ideologues on the Supreme Court — continue to try to tear us apart, I will continue to speak out bluntly about the danger they pose to the AANHPI community, immigrants, and other vulnerable groups.** [**Peter, my work has always been powered by grassroots supporters like you, and I wouldn’t have it any other way. Y’all — it’s Teacher Appreciation Week. And while I hope you recognize the educators in your life with a bouquet of flowers or a few words of gratitude — I know what I want for this Teacher Appreciation Week (as a former special education teacher of nearly three decades): **_[Leaders in Washington who know what it’s like to manage a classroom, support their students’ goals, and give the next generation the education they deserve. Point blank, we need more educators in Congress. Take this one-question poll to tell me if you agree >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84510559/471738575/898269246?refcode=ea.bf469f27-ab0c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.bf469f27-ab0c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZjQ2OWYyNy1hYjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j79KspCDTes0opxMpkinfv72pcFNJ-i7E2haD-Y6O4k=&emci=b9e32db8-a10c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=bf469f27-ab0c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=46764483)_** I think it’s pretty clear that if more leaders in Washington had worked in a public school — heck, if they had even _stepped inside_ a public school in the last decade — things would be different. With more educators in public office, we’d see:
* \- Common sense gun safety reform — so our students can learn without the fear of another school shooting.

* \- An end to the right-wing attacks on our curriculum & culture war legislation — so teachers can do their damn jobs and educate our kids.

* \- Public education teachers and staff receiving fair compensation for the hours and experience they give to their students every single day.

I think that’s what our kids deserve. **_[But what do you think? Take just 30 seconds of your time to tell me if you think we need more educators serving in Congress.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84510560/471738576/898269246?refcode=ea.bf469f27-ab0c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.bf469f27-ab0c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZjQ2OWYyNy1hYjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j79KspCDTes0opxMpkinfv72pcFNJ-i7E2haD-Y6O4k=&emci=b9e32db8-a10c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=bf469f27-ab0c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=46764483)_** | [**TAKE THE POLL**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84510561/471738577/898269246?refcode=ea.bf469f27-ab0c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.bf469f27-ab0c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZjQ2OWYyNy1hYjBjLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j79KspCDTes0opxMpkinfv72pcFNJ-i7E2haD-Y6O4k=&emci=b9e32db8-a10c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=bf469f27-ab0c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=46764483)

And while I hope you recognize the educators in your life with a bouquet of flowers or a few words of gratitude — I know what I want for this Teacher Appreciation Week (as a former special education teacher of nearly three decades): I think it’s pretty clear that if more leaders in Washington had worked in a public school — heck, if they had even stepped inside a public school in the last decade — things would be different. Happy Teacher Appreciation Day! Today, we celebrate the remarkable educators teaching our nation’s students -- and we acknowledge the work we still have left to do to ensure they have the resources and support they need to succeed, day in and day out. I taught high school before going to law school, so I know firsthand how demanding life in the classroom can be, and I’m grateful that President Biden and Vice President Harris have taken so many steps in the last three years to support educators nationwide. Here are just a few of them:
* Through the American Rescue Plan, **the Biden-Harris administration has supported early childhood programs** \-- helping K-12 schools across the country reopen after the height of the COVID pandemic, hiring more educators, boosting salaries, increasing mental health services, and expanding afterschool and summer programs.

* President Biden and Vice President Harris have also worked hard to help public service employees -- including educators -- through **student loan forgiveness.**

* **And they’ve taken crucial steps to keep our educators and students safe at school,** signing into law the most significant gun safety law in nearly three decades, while also authorizing more than $1 billion in mental health services, enabling schools to hire and train thousands of new mental health professionals.

These victories have never come easily, but we have refused to back down in the face of hardship or stray from our commitment to protect one another. Now, facing new challenges like SB4 and DACA likely heading back to the Supreme Court, we find ourselves in another fight: One for permanent protections. If we allow MAGA Republicans to successfully implement SB4 or kill DACA before Democrats deliver the permanent protections they promised our communities, we have the potential to lose the victories we’ve fought so hard for. **We could lose our health coverage, our right to work and get an education, and face a greater risk of deportation.** We have a mandate to ourselves and our communities to stop these attacks. clean_body: This new rule proves that when immigrant youth organize, we win. | | | Peter, The Biden Administration just announced a new rule that grants coverage under the Affordable Care Act to DACA recipients! This is a HUGE win for our community — one we’ve been fighting for since DACA was announced almost twelve years ago. Immigrant youth continue to show that when we fight for our communities, we win. These victories have never come easily, but we have refused to back down in the face of hardship or stray from our commitment to protect one another. Now, facing new challenges like SB4 and DACA likely heading back to the Supreme Court, we find ourselves in another fight: One for permanent protections. If we allow MAGA Republicans to successfully implement SB4 or kill DACA before Democrats deliver the permanent protections they promised our communities, we have the potential to lose the victories we’ve fought so hard for. We could lose our health coverage, our right to work and get an education, and face a greater risk of deportation. We have a mandate to ourselves and our communities to stop these attacks. This year, we must mobilize voters to the polls to elect pro-immigrant champions who we can push to deliver the expansive legislative victories that protect our fundamental rights over our bodies, our health, our safety, and our futures. We know that when we have the resources on our side, we can win major victories for our community. Peter,

This is former Navy SEAL and current Montana U.S. Senate candidate Tim Sheehy.

I have run directly into enemy fire without regard for my life for my fellow servicemembers and Americans; I have played the role of a human shield. I have carried wounded teammates across the battlefield because I was trained never to leave a man behind–and I never will. _**I didn’t do any of this so that spoiled liberal arts students could spit on and burn the American flag in support of Hamas.**_****

We’ve all read and watched as far-left progressives on college campuses take their universities hostage in the name of humanitarianism and solidarity with the terrorist organization Hamas. We’ve watched them tear down Old Glory and replace it with the Palestinian flag.

It’s unconscionable.

body:
Taking these 3 easy steps is one of the best ways you can support our work without giving any money at all.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240507-1&t=1&akid=660%2E587540%2EkQLkF0)
Peter,
You know how conservatives are always screaming about being censored online? Well, the reality is some email providers like Google are actively making it harder for progressive organizations — including Leaders We Deserve — to get our emails into your inboxes.
It’s probably pretty obvious by now, but email fundraising is responsible for a very large part of our budget. And having our messages fail to reach our supporters is a pretty big deal! We count on your support to help our endorsed candidates win.
**So today, instead of asking for money, we’re hoping you will take three simple steps to ensure our emails always reach your inbox:**
1. Add us to your contact list so we don’t get sent to your spam box. And if you ever do see an email from us in there, make sure to mark it as “Not Spam!”
2. Keep opening our emails. If you leave our emails unopened, it makes it more likely they’ll go to spam. And as much as it pains me to say this, you should click the unsubscribe button at the bottom if you don’t want to receive them anymore!
3. Reply to this email and let us know why you’re supporting Leaders We Deserve and which candidates you’re most excited about. _We might even feature some of our favorite responses in an upcoming email or ad!_

We depend on the funds we raise from these emails to help every single candidate we support, from Nadarius Clark last year in Virginia to the 12 outstanding candidates we’ve endorsed so far this cycle.
**So it might seem trivial, but taking the 3 easy steps above is actually one of the best ways you can support our work without giving any money at all.**
Thanks for helping out, Peter. We’ll be in touch with more updates soon!
David Hogg

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Peter, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

2024 is an incredibly important election year, and there are great candidates worth supporting up and down the ballot. And with so many worthy campaigns competing for your attention, today we wanted to send a quick message to explain **three key reasons you should support Sarah this year!**

1. **Sarah will make history as the first openly trans member of Congress.** When the far-right tries to use the LGBTQ+ community as a scapegoat for their own policy failures, Sarah will be there to stand up to them and show everyone that trans people belong at the table.

body:
Last week, Lauren Boebert decided to make fun of President Biden for tweeting a positive message about mental health.
__ | | | [](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=ec163825fb4646ec8b503cf59afed3be&_e=Er3Lq1qJ732YFZbf08eZc73_EFUATSx53mTZY_nQ9jetLthrCZVjmJ8iqjE4ER0CYWMzK-k1qSQ3N5GC9C7f1Kf6I0MPFBNnAmWDadpnWg1YCtnqjG4O-kGkzLsfis0i5HOIC7nFESDM_uuRmg8LDaNpXL929qMWbmaIEsfbo8vSIZKx7W1CrR0WrIGSR8Tj5PoymbWkskjZ-NeX5aLby-s7l4hDw0gfgRL_MAeIjjoEHeYGeenTlFX8Z3qX27TFC8HEBezJwbKTUFIgxAIBEwn-vqZlaHR2eVqXJuA020LphHsTUjwWHYhTrsIiuOvu1wvPToxFafsi0Whai6LyUcjYdxFDK3mwIWizZgPL2-Bk2bBjHH7ruLpc7yPOb3MW4y8wjHPkakGWcNe5XqGGEg%3D%3D) Last week, Lauren Boebert decided to make fun of President Biden for tweeting a positive message about mental health. name: Marina Jenkins
subject: Voter turnout went up 133%
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
I want to share two things with you:
|
---

Friends,
I want to share two things with you — one is disappointing, and the other is encouraging.
First, new findings from the Brennan Center show that since the _Shelby County_ case gutted the Voting Rights Act, the voter turnout gap between white and Black voters has increased, especially in places that used to be protected by key provisions in the law.
Unfortunately, what this means is that the _Shelby_ decision heralded in a new era of restrictive voting laws that disproportionately hurt communities of color.
Meanwhile, the proliferation of legislative maps that deliberately dilute the votes of Black Americans, excluding too many from the political process, has exacerbated this reality.
**But here’s something encouraging. This year, after the fair maps movement successfully fought to create a second Black-opportunity congressional district in Alabama — so the state’s representatives can more accurately reflect the will of the people — voter turnout in that district’s primary went up 133%!**
It’s clear that Alabama’s new representative map is a boon for political participation. That’s great news for democracy. When voters know they have an equal opportunity to elect a candidate of their choice, they are more motivated to show up to the polls and fulfill their civic duties.
The extraordinary increase in voter turnout not only highlights the power of fairness in our electoral system, but also that previously gerrymandered maps were detrimental to voter turnout and discouraged voters from engaging in the political process altogether.
The simple takeaway from this is that when voters feel they will be heard, progress can occur. **This is why we do the work, team.**
**We’ll never stop working for fair maps that make people free to make their voices heard — but we can’t do it without you.[ I hope this encouraging data inspires you to make a donation to All On The Line today so we can keep up our important work. ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84515302/471753511/608781345?refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_mayfun_email_20240507-AOTL-Unfortunately-Marina&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk2N2ZlN2NmLWI0MGMtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=tYcgHAr_G6pYKz4NurIYkI1Rqsa-P3pvGaGIw208xvg=)**

clean_body: I want to share two things with you: | Friends, I want to share two things with you — one is disappointing, and the other is encouraging. First, new findings from the Brennan Center show that since the Shelby County case gutted the Voting Rights Act, the voter turnout gap between white and Black voters has increased, especially in places that used to be protected by key provisions in the law. Unfortunately, what this means is that the Shelby decision heralded in a new era of restrictive voting laws that disproportionately hurt communities of color. Meanwhile, the proliferation of legislative maps that deliberately dilute the votes of Black Americans, excluding too many from the political process, has exacerbated this reality. But here’s something encouraging. This year, after the fair maps movement successfully fought to create a second Black-opportunity congressional district in Alabama — so the state’s representatives can more accurately reflect the will of the people — voter turnout in that district’s primary went up 133%! It’s clear that Alabama’s new representative map is a boon for political participation. That’s great news for democracy. When voters know they have an equal opportunity to elect a candidate of their choice, they are more motivated to show up to the polls and fulfill their civic duties. The extraordinary increase in voter turnout not only highlights the power of fairness in our electoral system, but also that previously gerrymandered maps were detrimental to voter turnout and discouraged voters from engaging in the political process altogether. The simple takeaway from this is that when voters feel they will be heard, progress can occur. This is why we do the work, team. body:
Join the Team

| | | | | | | |

| | | |
---
| | | **Celebrate Teacher Appreciation Week with Carmen Goers****!**
---

Dear Peter,
This Teacher Appreciation Week, let's take a moment to honor the incredible educators in Washington’s 8th congressional district. Hey, it's Harry—the Capitol Police officer who defended the Capitol, and our democracy, on January 6.

I cannot believe we're just 7 days from this election.

Between early voting and vote-by-mail, thousands of voters are already making their choice on who is best equipped to protect our democracy and serve MD-03 in Congress.
