body:
Jason Crow For Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/logoJC%20(1).png]
Dan Goldman served as lead majority counsel during the first Trump impeachment trial. Now, he's fighting up against MAGA extremism in Congress alongside Jason Crow. Read his message below, then consider splitting a donation between his and Jason’s campaigns.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/crow-split-goldman [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/crow-split-goldman]

Hi, this is Congressman Dan Goldman from NY-10. I was lead majority counsel during the first Trump impeachment trial — and since then, I’ve borne the brunt of many MAGA attacks.

I can’t believe I’m saying this, but Marjorie Taylor Greene told me to ”shut the f*** up”.

I’m past the point of being surprised by Marjorie Taylor Greene’s lack of decorum, but this might be a new low — even for her.

During a House Oversight Committee hearing, Chairman Comer was yammering on about Republicans’ sham impeachment inquiry against President Biden. When I interjected, Marjorie Taylor Greene loudly told me to “shut up,” then moments later mouthed to me, “shut the f*** up.”

This is where today’s Republican Party stands. Majorie Taylor Greene’s behavior is not only normalized within the Republican Party but is often even applauded. It’s deeply concerning that Republicans can’t engage in political discourse without resorting to childish behavior.

I’ve been vocal about House Republicans’ blatant abuse of power in pursuing a baseless impeachment against the president, and Republicans like Marjorie Taylor Greene don’t appreciate me calling out their investigation for what it is: a baseless sham investigation that was infiltrated by spies from both Russia and China.

We can expect the MAGA attacks to keep coming my way, but I can guarantee one thing for certain: I won’t shut up. And I won’t stop standing up for the truth and the rule of law as Republicans sow chaos and division to chip away at our democratic institutions.

So please, if you can, split a donation between Jason Crow and my campaign to help us get even louder about defending the truth, our democracy, and the rule of law in Congress: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/crow-split-goldman]

Join General Flynn in Blakely, PA, this Thursday, May 9th, for a screening of the blockbuster film FLYNN -- Deliver the Truth, Whatever the Cost. This film is a captivating documentary that delves deep into the life and trials of General Michael T. Flynn. The film takes the audience on a journey through the remarkable career of General Flynn, beginning with his commendable rise through the ranks of the United States Military. As a highly respected intelligence officer and a three-star general, General Flynn's career was marked by his dedication to his country and his exceptional leadership skills. The documentary exposes the intricate web of political intrigue and the severe persecution General Flynn faced after exposing deep-seated corruption within the corridors of power. It provides an insider's view of the challenges and controversies that surrounded General Flynn during this critical period of American politics.
General Flynn will take questions from the audience after the film. Catch General Flynn at Peckville Assembly of God Church this Thursday, May 9th. Doors open at 5pm. body:
#
Hi friend, can I tell you a quick story about this photo?
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-schiff-split.Zc1pr1&refcode=em24507-1-t12&t=1&akid=5296%2E196590%2E9W_JIT)
That's me in 1985 — just 24 years old at my law school graduation, fresh off a student research assistant job for Professor Laurence Tribe, thinking that I had just completed the toughest challenge of my academic career. Well, up to that point, anyway. (The bar exam was still a few weeks away).
Some years later, I would become an Assistant United States Attorney, and successfully prosecute the first FBI agent charged with espionage, Richard Miller, for spying for the Soviet Union.
As a new graduate of law school, I could never have imagined I would handle a case like that. Or that I would later investigate a president who also betrayed our country ...
...lead his impeachment and Senate trial...
...serve on the January 6 Committee...
...get kicked off the Intelligence Committee by a craven Speaker of the House for doing the above...
...and get censured by extreme partisan MAGA House Republicans under the personal threat of that corrupt president...
Life leads us in uncertain and fortuitous ways. I’m fortunate that at a time when our country has been in trouble, and our democracy at risk, I have been in a position to help do something about it.
In the Senate, I hope to do even more.

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=035119c285d54091896fa233a4e945c4&_e=1gyqDmXEi69bAxRqS2DpU-nRKxzKJYk2UBLHlpZOI2bOa23sTPurnUJm5lVc_RlbqRO_L2sXZf_vonGzGTfp-kYCDKtOcFeimJRdMCgx-RikvgdlcE-EAotp3CFxM9Af9dk0-Ong-XsIdwgC0OTtguT3XLXoaz6C7f0LfAWheB6uYY3NTXxXWnlWqFu0UXuolgsEeD3uLLH4SpVWLisTpLX_gz8JLd2_-1IEfzG8tFfEc-YHP9yOcZqeTjvv08roCHe2MNxNE6NJ-GtzIsRJ-pn6okJkIXfc9DQSt_bdEihr5F1_tOcOAChaBWYaOZDqRg9-JUVMpSB6rCaF5FYQHJer0G92h3Fj25L7bj5rDQ-16PUlvj8vyUci1iL-GgNrOUZuDLjA6gAYLxg_JlmHWd9AhgcoXnc0GAJnDCYC9uI%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Thank you for your urgent support,

**Senator Joni Ernst**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:
__OPEN TODAY: We need your help to respond. |
---

|
Peter -- this is moving quickly: House Republicans have just voted to shred protections for millions of acres of land in the Arctic, along with nearly a half dozen votes just last week to overturn critical environmental protections. [Real quick -- we need your help to respond to their relentless attacks on our environment. Please, renew your LCV membership right now to power our campaigns. Even $5 makes a difference >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Ap9dcYgVD-)

Without warning or time for adequate debate, MAGA extremists in the House held votes on a number of bills to overturn important environmental protections. Here are just a few of their destructive bills:

Fellow Patriot,

I'm sure by now you've seen the news about pro-Hamas agitators taking over university campuses. Our hearts are breaking at the sight of the increasing unrest.

But what the liberal media is not telling you are the ways that woke university administrators are siding with the radical Hamas sympathizers!

Just this week, a Jewish student at UCLA _was stopped from entering a college building because he is Jewish. _

Antisemitism like this has no place in America.

**[That's why Young America's Foundation is fighting back](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ceeb5435c7104bc084e16965886b0c29&_e=sCwV0sdRC4xNNgtqF4SX_hYoR8cgTW_MIKT3I6T1GFBaUGfb1O62J4uBclRrStePnxZpvyd26L96AWGy9sd9OJcuEAhLcOJmpL9rQwzAz6dxWO_gPQHWnKQV-v5FeDVSRl5yUjLs3Qw-lwhSTJitNf-jhTwHUtSd1zA1ngeiylBlOSPxWKdIX-k49klDtRC6RgIKl3S58YF7MCI8QIKffYZVMrvi0G0jP848O5Q4goUcnc9lCGM-ETqfN7nsdvGXo0NF12bzfrz9QKkX3ZP3G7j7soMlJezucH3ypG8pOKRrVgOQNU4IYGNZl9fmUD9Rvu24N-Ewnx29oiN9bqeQ2Ag5ydzS5ldf1cv-b_b4WJ6lIC1Ga6pY2pfkT565LwRXibqIJDTfpone_oL1IXo5nA%3D%3D)****and dispatching one of the world 's leading experts on Jihad, Robert Spencer, to UCLA to expose the truth about Hamas and its reign of terror.**

However, UCLA officials are stonewalling and trying to prevent the event from happening.

**Matthew Weinberg** , the chairman of the UCLA YAF chapter hosting Spencer, said, "The people in the encampments are frankly violating campus policy, and nothing is being done about it. People are being physically assaulted; we just want a free speech event, and we're being told no."

Imagine being a Jewish student and being told you can't hear from a preeminent Jewish foreign policy expert, but that pro-Hamas agitators can continue to threaten your safety.

Make no mistake, the current encampments of radical pro-Hamas agitators on university campuses are the direct result of _decades_ of woke, Leftist indoctrination by college administrators and professors. They have demonized conservative and Jewish voices, and now their indoctrination is bearing the bitter fruit of campus violence.

We need to raise the alarm _now_ before this unrest spreads.

**Specifically, we are looking for 100 patriots to step forward before midnight with a gift of $50 to Young America 's Foundation, so we can expose these UCLA administrators and every school administration that is cozying up to radical Jihad and Hamas. **

Your gift will help send leading conservative speakers like **Ben Shapiro** and **Robert Spencer** to campuses like UCLA so they can warn students about the lies and danger of Hamas. It will also support conservative and Jewish students on campuses by equipping them with conservative toolkits, pro-Israel resources, and legal protection from the universities that seek to suppress their First Amendment right to free speech.

**Can you make a gift today to support these students?** Here's a secure link where you can quickly make your gift and ensure that students can hear the truth from conservative experts before they fall victim to pro-Hamas lies: **[https://secure.yaf.org/expose-pro-hamas-college-administrators](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ceeb5435c7104bc084e16965886b0c29&_e=sCwV0sdRC4xNNgtqF4SX_hYoR8cgTW_MIKT3I6T1GFBaUGfb1O62J4uBclRrStePnxZpvyd26L96AWGy9sd9OJcuEAhLcOJmpL9rQwzAz6dxWO_gPQHWnKQV-v5FeDVSRl5yUjLs3Qw-lwhSTJitNf-jhTwHUtSd1zA1ngeiylBlOSPxWKdIX-k49klDtRC6RgIKl3S58YF7MCI8QIKffYZVMrvi0G0jP848O5Q4goWkEud5P7XcMfs06JCQvhviTmmTvJtFvrbDtE-c_12J-iAuxdhADuap1b8Qehf8xYY_eGzro9QrOMuNaXqIW8h6uYqx6eaGV1GwYA6mjee612A_YLd7qkZzlvcLK4DEWOcWJcmfBmncxmI_npuykpRBkG8_cPyf4yn4Bl6XY6aF7Q%3D%3D)**

Lorinser campaign responds to Callie Barr's irresponsible legal challenge to petitions
https://www.votedrbob.com/post/lorinser-campaign-responds-to-callie-barr-s-irresponsible-legal-challenge-to-petitions [https://www.votedrbob.com/post/lorinser-campaign-responds-to-callie-barr-s-irresponsible-legal-challenge-to-petitions]
Bob Lorinser's Democratic primary opponent, Callie Barr, filed a challenge to Lorinser's nomination petition signatures in an attempt to disqualify him from the August ballot.
READ OUR FULL RESPONSE [https://www.votedrbob.com/post/lorinser-campaign-responds-to-callie-barr-s-irresponsible-legal-challenge-to-petitions]
Friends,
Barr based most of the challenge on her false assumption that circulators must collect all signatures in a 180-day window before filing. The law is crystal clear—this rule does not apply [https://www.votedrbob.com/post/lorinser-campaign-responds-to-callie-barr-s-irresponsible-legal-challenge-to-petitions] to the Democratic Congressional Primary.
Barr filed challenges to signatures without any legitimate cause. It appears her sole goal was to contest enough nominations to disqualify Lorinser, regardless of their merit.
Ms. Barr used extremely inaccurate data, a flawed unofficial database, and irresponsible misinterpretations of the election code in her effort to discard and disenfranchise voters.
The challenge is a callous attack on the integrity of the democratic election process. This is unexpected from a fellow Democrat.
Callie Barr's attempt to disqualify Lorinser is entirely feckless.
Callie Barr poorly orchestrated an inept effort to remove Lorinser from the ballot, which only highlighted her malice, pettiness, and disregard for the people's will. According to counsel, election officials should categorically dismiss the meritless claims. Lorinser will most assuredly appear on the ballot in August.
This is not the way to earn voters' respect and trust.
Onward,
-Team Lorinser
➤ OUR FULL RESPONSE ➤ [https://www.votedrbob.com/post/lorinser-campaign-responds-to-callie-barr-s-irresponsible-legal-challenge-to-petitions]

**Are you ready to build the NEW TRUMP MAJORITY, Peter?**

Senate Republicans and bold Republican challengers competing in close elections across America are fighting to secure a new Trump Majority.

A New Trump Majority will enable us to stop Joe Biden's border invasion, protect 2nd Amendment rights, stand with America's ally Israel to defeat Hamas, stop DEI and gender ideology from ruining public schools, end the Biden crime crisis, and seize critical political opportunities when they arise.

_I will travel all over America to support bold Republican candidates for Senate competing in the closest races._

We MUST rebuild the Trump Majority, or America is in for four more years of severe decline.

**I don't have to tell you how bad things have gotten with Joe Biden in charge -you already know from your grocery receipts, utility bills, and gas station trips that our economy is in a major downslide, and the dollar is not as strong as it once was.**

We can turn all this around. None of it is happening by accident. It is ALL happening because of Joe Biden and the Democrats' America Last policy agenda that lets violent criminals terrorize the streets without fear of police and puts illegal immigrants before American citizens.

It would even prevent states like Connecticut from issuing our own efficiency standards if the federal government, under a future Republican administration, rolled the federal standards back. So much for the “states’ rights” argument that the GOP has used to hide behind their disastrous Trump-enabled agenda. The vote today to pass another unserious MAGA Republican messaging bill would hurt workers, risk **2.25 million energy efficiency jobs** — _more than all fossil fuel jobs combined_ — and increase utility bills for everyday Americans. DOE energy standards will save Americans nearly **$1 trillion** over the next 30 years, keep **2.5 billion tons of carbon emissions out of our atmosphere** , and add **550,000 jobs** to the economy by the end of the decade **and** not affect any existing appliances. Your gas stoves are safe! [**My opponent George Logan would be another rubber stamp for MAGA Republicans and their unserious agenda with environmentally destructive votes like the one they just took today. In reality, this bill is a dead giveaway to utility providers, which would rake in an additional $500 a year from every American due to the raised energy bills and repealed Department of Energy efficiency standards that this bill represents. It would even prevent states like Connecticut from issuing our own efficiency standards if the federal government, under a future Republican administration, rolled the federal standards back. So much for the “states’ rights” argument that the GOP has used to hide behind their disastrous Trump-enabled agenda. The vote today to pass another unserious MAGA Republican messaging bill would hurt workers, risk 2.25 million energy efficiency jobs — more than all fossil fuel jobs combined — and increase utility bills for everyday Americans. That is why I voted no. Republicans will tell you this is a ban — yet another one of their alternative facts. Hello Peter,
---
| | Earlier this month,**history was made in our state.** In a groundbreaking move, workers at the Volkswagen plant in Chattanooga have made their voices heard loud and clear by voting to unionize with the United Auto Workers (UAW). This isn't just another headline—it's a game-changer for all of us.

This momentous occasion proves something crucial: **Tennessee is the bellwether of change.** Despite what Republicans want you to believe, our state is not just a red stronghold. We're a diverse, dynamic community with a rich history of standing up for what's right. And this UAW victory is a testament to that spirit.

Tennessee has a long history of labor activism and progressive values. From the coal mines of East Tennessee to the bustling streets of Nashville, our state has always been a hotbed of working-class solidarity. Now, with this latest win, we're showing the world that Tennessee can be **BLUE.**

But our work is far from over. We need to keep pushing for change, keep fighting for the rights of workers, and keep building a Tennessee that works for everyone, not just the wealthy few. And that's where you come in.

We're calling on all of you to spread the word about this victory by and for the working people. let your friends, family, and followers know that Tennessee is leading the charge for progress. **Together, we can amplify this message and show the world what our state is truly capable of.**
